Mr. Roofer lists GAF Certified Plus, CertainTeed ShingleMaster, Owens Corning Preferred Contractor and BRAVA Authorized Contractor credentials, a BBB A+ rating and a 10-year workmanship warranty on roof installations. Call to arrange a free inspection and estimate for repair or replacement work.
tips: Ask for a written inspection report and estimate.
Take photos of any visible damage before calling.
Ask how the 10-year workmanship warranty and material warranties apply to your roof.

name: Bird's Eye Roofing
desc: Bird's Eye Roofing handles roof inspections, repairs and full replacements for homeowners, businesses and HOAs in Alpharetta and the surrounding area. The company works with insurance claims, and customers mention drone inspections to find leaks. Its office is now on Woodstock Road in Roswell, where walk-ins are welcome.
tips: Call or text to request a free roof inspection.
Walk-ins are welcome at the Roswell office.
Ask about help with insurance claims after storm damage.
about: Bird's Eye Roofing handles roof inspections, repairs and full replacements for homeowners, businesses and HOAs in Alpharetta and nearby communities, with service across Fulton, Cherokee, Cobb, Forsyth and Gwinnett counties. Owned by local residents Brandon Marsh and Calvin Cook, the company has been in business for more than 10 years, and its team averages about 15 years of roofing experience.

Repair work includes tracking down leaks, pipe boot repair, porch roofs and sidewall and chimney reflashing, and replacements feature shingle lines such as CertainTeed Landmark. The company has extensive experience with insurance claims after hail and storm damage, and it uses drones during inspections so customers can see what the crew sees. HOAs and property managers can ask about larger multi-home projects.
Its office is on Woodstock Road in Roswell, where walk-ins are welcome, and free roof inspections can be requested by call or text.

name: Modification Roofing
desc: Residential and commercial roofing from minor repairs to full replacements.
about: Modification Roofing is a licensed and insured roofing company with its Atlanta office at 2475 Northwinds Parkway, Suite 200, in Alpharetta. It is part of Mod Tree Corporation and also runs offices in Nashville, Miami and Mobile, serving customers across the Southeast.

The company handles residential and commercial work, from minor roof repairs to full roof replacements. Its listed services include shingle roofing, metal and tin roofing, rubber roofing for low slope roofs, gutters, siding and residential renovation, so one contractor can cover the roof and related exterior work. Estimates and proposals are free.

It is an option for homeowners and business owners who need a leak fixed, storm damage addressed or an older roof replaced. The Northwinds Parkway office is in the office corridor near GA 400 and Haynes Bridge Road. Call to arrange an inspection and estimate before any repair or replacement work begins, and ask for the scope of work in writing.
tips: Ask for a free written estimate and inspection photos.
Ask whether they assist with insurance claims after storm damage.
Confirm warranty terms before signing.

name: Roof Depot
desc: Roof Depot is a roofing and exterior contractor founded in 1998 that works with homebuilders, developers, property managers, commercial owners and homeowners. Services include re-roofing, tear-offs, new construction roofs, flat roof repairs, sheet metal flashing, gutters and siding for single-family, multifamily and light industrial properties.
tips: Ask about maintenance and inspection programs for managed properties.
The toll-free line is 1-800-697-6633.
Homeowners should ask whether their job will be handled by America's Best Choice.
about: Roof Depot is a roofing and exterior contractor founded in 1998, with its office at 705 Hembree Place in Roswell. The company describes itself as a national partner for homebuilders, general contractors, developers and property managers, with active operations in more than 20 states supported by regional field offices.

Services include re-roofing, tear-offs and new construction roofs in shingle, metal, TPO and modified bitumen, along with flat roof repairs, custom sheet metal flashing, gutters, and fiber cement, engineered wood and vinyl siding for single-family, multifamily and light industrial properties. Property managers can set up preventive maintenance, inspection and emergency leak response programs.

Roof Depot focuses mainly on business and institutional clients. Residential homeowner roof replacements and repairs are handled through America's Best Choice, a company owned by Roof Depot, so homeowners may be directed there for a quote.

name: TruCare Restoration
desc: TruCare Restoration is a roofing contractor with an Alpharetta office on Cicero Drive and a second office in Fayetteville. It repairs and replaces shingle and metal roofs, installs gutters and handles storm, hail, wind, tree and fire damage, including help with insurance claims, across metro Atlanta.
tips: Request a free next-day roof inspection after a storm.
Ask for help filing and managing an insurance claim.
Ask for the warranty terms in writing before signing.
about: TruCare Restoration is a family-owned roofing and exterior contractor with an Alpharetta office at 11175 Cicero Drive, Suite 187, and a second office on Bastille Way in Fayetteville. It repairs and replaces shingle and metal roofs, installs gutters and handles storm, hail, wind, tree and fire damage across roughly two dozen metro Atlanta communities, from Acworth to Woodstock.

Beyond residential roofing, the company works on siding, windows, decks, exterior painting and roof coatings, and its commercial crews handle built-up, single-ply, modified bitumen and metal roofs. Each project is assigned a dedicated project manager, and the company advertises a 25-year roof warranty, a satisfaction guarantee and no markup on materials.
The company helps homeowners with insurance claims and offers free next-day inspections and estimates. Hours run Monday through Saturday, 7am to 7pm.

name: Atlanta Classic Tree Service
desc: Atlanta Classic Tree Service has cared for trees in Alpharetta and the Atlanta area since 1987, with ISA-certified arborists. Services include tree removal, pruning, stump grinding, bracing and tree health care for homes and businesses in downtown Alpharetta, Crabapple, North Point and nearby areas.
tips: Ask about cabling and bracing for weak or split trees.
Request an arborist assessment for discolored or declining trees.
Call during weekday office hours to schedule an estimate.
about: Atlanta Classic Tree Service has cared for trees in Alpharetta and the Atlanta area since 1987, when it was founded by an arborist. ISA-certified arborists are on staff, and its office is at 4975 Atlanta Highway, Suite 100.

Services include tree removal for hazardous, storm damaged or unwanted trees, pruning to clear dead limbs and shape growth, stump grinding and emergency tree work. The company also offers cabling and bracing to support weak limbs, lightning protection for tall or historic trees, and deep root fertilization. Less common offerings include wood shavings delivery for stalls, paddocks or mulch, and maintenance of detention and retention ponds.

It works with homeowners, businesses and property managers, and its service area covers downtown Alpharetta, Crabapple, North Point, Windward, Avalon and nearby communities such as Roswell, Johns Creek and Sandy Springs. The office is open weekdays and closed on weekends, so plan to call during the workweek to schedule an estimate.

name: AAA Pro Tree
desc: AAA Pro Tree is a tree care company led by a certified arborist and horticulturist with over 30 years of experience in Alpharetta, Johns Creek and surrounding areas. It handles tree removal including hazardous trees, trimming and pruning, emergency storm work, stump removal and land clearing.
tips: Call or text (770) 231-9065 for a free estimate
Emergency storm and fallen-tree service is available
Sunday appointments can be arranged ahead of time
about: AAA Pro Tree is a family-owned, licensed and insured tree company led by a certified arborist and horticulturist. The company says it has served Alpharetta, Johns Creek and neighboring communities for more than 30 years, and its customer reviews mention owner Mark working alongside family members on the crew.

Services cover full tree removal including hazardous trees, trimming and pruning, stump grinding and removal, land clearing and emergency storm response. The crew focuses on fast help when a storm drops a tree or a dead limb hangs over a house, and the company advertises a 100% service guarantee.

Estimates are free and the company says it walks the property first so pricing is clear before work begins. The service area includes Alpharetta, Johns Creek, Roswell, Milton, Peachtree Corners and Sandy Springs. Office hours run Monday through Saturday, with Sunday visits by appointment.

name: 72 Tree Seed & Land Co
desc: 72 Tree, Seed & Land Co. provides tree removal, trimming, pruning and emergency storm cleanup in Alpharetta, Roswell and Atlanta, along with arborist consultations and ecological restoration. The company says it has offered tree removal for over 40 years and handles large, dangerous trees around the clock.
tips: Call (678) 223-5495 any time for emergency tree removal
Ask them to work directly with your insurer on storm claims
Request an arborist consultation before removing a large or valuable tree
about: 72 Tree, Seed & Land Co. is an Alpharetta-based tree care and arboriculture consulting company that reports more than 40 years in the business and over 14,000 customers. It describes itself as a third-generation organization combining arboriculture, construction and land management, with ISA Certified Arborists supervising its jobs.

Day to day, the crew handles tree removal, pruning to ANSI A300 standards, crane work, large tree transplanting and planting, and emergency storm recovery around the clock. It also offers arborist consultations, construction consulting, land and site development and ecological restoration work.

Homeowners dealing with storm damage may find the insurance help useful, since the company says it will handle the claim for you. Its 24 hour emergency coverage reaches Alpharetta, Roswell, Milton, Johns Creek, Sandy Springs, Dunwoody, Suwanee, Marietta, Kennesaw and Woodstock.

name: Stump Grinder Company
desc: Stump Grinder Company has ground stumps for homes and businesses since 1998, and owner-operator Kevin Carnegie took over from founder Kevin Grady after a training transition that began in 2020. Beyond stump grinding it helps with big stump removal, prep for new sod or plantings, and clearing for decks, fences and driveways.
tips: Text a photo of the stump for a quick ballpark quote
Measure the stump at its base, not the top of the cut
Same-day service is sometimes available; office hours are weekdays 9 to 5 and Saturday 10 to 2
about: Stump Grinder Company is an independently owned Alpharetta business that has ground stumps across north metro Atlanta since May 1998. Founder Kevin Grady began training Kevin Carnegie in early 2020 to take over, and Carnegie now owns and operates the company. It reports helping more than 10,000 residential and commercial customers.

The main machine is a Rayco RG80 stump cutter with an 85 HP engine that fits through a 43 inch gate and leaves compostable mulch on site. Beyond single stumps, the company grinds out hedgerows, removes very large stumps and clears ground ahead of new sod, plantings, decks, fences, patios, parking pads and driveways.

Pricing is based on measuring the base of each stump, and the website explains how to measure. A ballpark quote is often possible by texting a photo, and the team can help locate utilities before grinding.

name: Nextgen Pest Solutions
desc: Nextgen Pest Solutions is a veteran-owned pest control and wildlife removal company with an Alpharetta office on Prospect Place, serving homes and businesses across north Fulton ZIP codes. It treats insects and rodents, removes raccoons, snakes and squirrels, and uses kid, pet and eco-friendly treatments.
address: 100 Prospect Pl, Ste B, Alpharetta, GA 30005
tips: Ask about same-day service when you call (470) 375-0496
Request a free re-treatment if pests come back
Check the website for current first-service coupons
about: Nextgen Pest Solutions is a veteran-owned pest control and wildlife removal company with an office at 100 Prospect Place, Suite B, in Alpharetta. It serves homes and businesses in Georgia, Florida and Alabama and cites more than 20 years of pest and rodent control experience.

Residential work covers ants, bed bugs, mosquitoes, rodents, cockroaches, spiders and termites. The wildlife side handles bats, birds, raccoons, snakes, squirrels, chipmunks and armadillos. Commercial clients include restaurants, hotels, schools, medical facilities, government buildings and property managers.

The company says it uses kid, pet and eco-friendly treatments and backs its work with a free re-service guarantee if pests return between visits. Same-day or next-day appointments are available in most cases, with 24 hour emergency service for urgent infestations.

name: Synergy Landscape Group
desc: Full-service commercial and residential landscape company with over 15 years of experience.
address: 225 Tidwell Dr, Suite C, Alpharetta, GA 30004
about: Synergy Landscape Group is a full-service landscape company based in Suite C at 225 Tidwell Drive in Alpharetta. It serves residential and commercial clients in Alpharetta, Milton, Johns Creek and Roswell, and its team brings more than three decades of combined landscaping experience.

Work spans landscape design and installation, lawn care and maintenance, and seasonal planting. Hardscape projects include retaining walls, paver patios, fire pits and walkways, while outdoor living builds cover fireplaces, grill stations, outdoor kitchens and lighting. The crew also installs ponds, waterfalls and fountains and solves drainage problems with French drains, channel drains, dry creek beds and grading.

Projects start with a free consultation to discuss your goals for the property. The company emphasizes environmentally friendly products and methods and arrives in clearly marked vehicles. The office keeps weekday hours.
tips: Book a free design consultation before planning a patio or outdoor kitchen
Ask about drainage fixes if your yard holds water
Check the Specials page for current offers

name: Crabapple Landscape Experts
desc: Crabapple LandscapExperts is a locally owned commercial landscape firm in business since 1992, with its north branch on Union Center Drive. It provides landscape maintenance, lawn care, irrigation, stormwater management, landscape construction, seasonal color, lighting and tree work, and has worked on City of Alpharetta streetscapes and parks.
tips: Best suited to commercial, HOA and community properties.
Existing customers should go through their assigned account manager.
Call ahead to confirm which branch serves your property.
about: Crabapple LandscapExperts is a locally owned commercial landscape firm whose north branch is listed on Union Center Drive in Alpharetta. The company dates to 1992 and describes itself as a commercial landscaping company serving commercial and mixed-use properties and community associations across Georgia.

Its work falls into four areas: maintenance, including lawn care, irrigation and stormwater management; landscape construction; enhancements such as seasonal color, commercial lighting and tree trimming and removal; and design. Featured projects include City of Alpharetta streetscapes and parks, the McDonough Town Square project, a river restoration at the Deaton Creek community, work at Ponce City Market, a retaining wall at Howell Park and permeable paver installations. The Atlanta Business Chronicle has included it among the region's largest commercial landscape companies.
Office hours are listed as weekdays from 7am to 5pm. The firm is mainly set up for property managers and HOAs rather than individual homeowners.

name: Stoneunlimited Kitchen and Bath
desc: StoneUnlimited Kitchen + Bath is a design-build remodeler that handles kitchens, bathrooms, basements and other interiors for homeowners in Roswell, Alpharetta, Milton, Johns Creek and North Metro Atlanta. It manages projects from design and material selection through construction, and cites more than 20 years of remodeling experience.
tips: Schedule a showroom visit to see remnant stone for small projects
Bring rough countertop measurements for a faster estimate
Browse before-and-after photos and remodel videos on the website
about: StoneUnlimited Kitchen + Bath is a design-build remodeling company that has worked on homes in north metro Atlanta since 2003. Its showroom is at 1015 Mansell Road in Roswell, close to the Alpharetta line, and it serves Alpharetta, Milton, Johns Creek, Sandy Springs and East Cobb.

The team remodels kitchens, primary and secondary bathrooms, basements and other interior spaces, and also offers cabinet painting and refacing. The company's roots are in fabricating and installing stone countertops, and it works with granite, marble, soapstone, quartz brands and many tile types. Bathroom work includes curbless zero-entry showers.

A typical project moves from design to material selection to construction under one project manager, with the company coordinating cabinetry, tile, plumbing, electrical, carpentry and paint. Small jobs can use remnant stone, which you view during a scheduled showroom visit.

name: Chem-Dry of Fulton-Forsyth
desc: Chem-Dry of Fulton-Forsyth is a locally owned franchise run by Clyde Miller that has served the Fulton and Forsyth area for more than 25 years. It cleans carpet, upholstery, leather and area rugs with a carbonated process that dries in a few hours, and also offers pet urine removal, tile and grout cleaning and granite renewal.
tips: Request a free quote online, by phone or by text.
Ask about pet urine treatment if odors are a concern.
Plan for a few hours of drying time after cleaning.
about: Chem-Dry of Fulton-Forsyth is a locally owned franchise of the national Chem-Dry brand, based at 71 Wills Drive in Alpharetta. Owner Clyde Miller has served Fulton and Forsyth counties for more than 25 years and has over 30 years with the Chem-Dry brand. The company says callers speak with Clyde directly rather than an answering service.

Listed services include carpet, upholstery, leather and area rug cleaning using Chem-Dry's carbonated process, which the company says uses about 80 percent less water than steam cleaning so carpets dry in a few hours. It also offers pet urine and odor removal, specialty stain removal, carpet protectant, tile and grout cleaning, wood floor cleaning, granite countertop renewal, commercial carpet cleaning and water extraction.

Service areas include Alpharetta, Cumming, Roswell, Johns Creek, Milton and Suwanee. Free price quotes are available by phone, text or online, and the company says it focuses on recommendations tailored to each job rather than upsells.

name: Good Boy Pool Services
desc: Weekly pool cleaning, equipment repair, seasonal openings and closings, and renovations.
about: Good Boy Pool Services is a pool care company that has served Alpharetta since 2021, along with Milton, Roswell, Cumming, Canton, Sandy Springs, Dunwoody and Atlanta. It works on both residential and commercial pools across Fulton, Gwinnett, Cobb and Cherokee counties.

Its core offering is a weekly all-inclusive cleaning service that follows a 15-step process, and the company also handles pool repairs and ongoing maintenance. Equipment repair, seasonal openings and closings and pool renovations have also been listed among its services, so ask about those when you call.

Quotes start with an online form or a phone call. The form asks for your address, pool type and size, whether you close your pool for the winter and how you prefer to be contacted, so have those details ready. Service is provided at your property rather than at a storefront.
tips: Call to confirm your neighborhood is in the service area.
Book spring openings early before the season gets busy.
Ask what the 15-step weekly cleaning visit includes.

name: Georgia Legacy Law Group
desc: Wills, trusts, probate, elder law and fiduciary litigation.
address: 11300 Atlantis Pl, Suite A, Alpharetta, GA 30022
about: Georgia Legacy Law Group is an estate planning and probate law firm at 11300 Atlantis Place in Alpharetta, in the office area off Old Milton Parkway. The firm was previously known as Hill & Watchko and before that as Bettis, Hill & Vann, a practice established in 2010 with roots in Phill Bettis's Bettis Law Group in Forsyth County.

Its practice areas include wills, trusts and estate planning, probate and estate and trust administration, elder law and long-term care planning, special needs planning, guardianships and conservatorships, asset protection and fiduciary litigation, along with business entity work. John Cleveland Hill serves as managing partner, and the attorney roster has included Rachel B. Keller, Laura McDonnell Barron and Madalyn S. Davis, with Phill Bettis and Laura Barfield Baxter of counsel.

Families typically turn to a firm like this when drafting or updating a will or trust, settling a loved one's estate, or planning for long-term care. Call the office to confirm current services and arrange a first meeting.
tips: Call ahead to schedule a consultation.
Bring copies of any existing wills, trusts or beneficiary forms.
Ask which attorney handles probate versus planning matters.

name: Hastings Shadmehry Family Law
desc: Hastings Shadmehry is an Alpharetta family law firm on Mansell Road that handles divorce and other family law matters, with its attorneys citing over 50 years of combined experience. The firm aims for solutions tailored to each family and also offers collaborative divorce and mediation.
tips: Schedule a consultation to talk through your situation before filing
Ask whether mediation could work for your case
Listen to the Forward Facing podcast for background on Georgia family law
about: Hastings Shadmehry is a family law firm in Suite 475 at 3650 Mansell Road in Alpharetta. Its attorneys work only in family law and cite more than 50 years of combined experience helping clients through divorce and related matters.

The firm handles divorce, child custody, child support and other family disputes, and it offers mediation as a less adversarial path. Its stated approach is to prepare every case for both settlement and trial, with a plan built around each family's full picture rather than a one-size-fits-all strategy.

Partners Andee Hastings and Mali Shadmehry also host Forward Facing, a podcast that walks through custody, divorce, support and complex litigation in plain terms. Listening to an episode can be a useful way to understand the process before booking a consultation. Office hours run Monday through Thursday until 5:30pm and Friday until 4:30pm.

name: Hecht Family Law
desc: Family law and estate planning on Deerfield Parkway.
address: 3225 North Point Pkwy, Suite 204, Alpharetta, GA 30005
about: Hecht Family Law is a Georgia family law firm with an Alpharetta office serving clients across metro Atlanta and the surrounding counties. Founding and managing attorney Ed Hecht went through his own divorce as the father of young children, and the firm says its attorneys bring more than 100 years of combined family law experience.

The practice focuses solely on family law, handling divorce, child custody, child support, alimony, adoption, annulment, grandparents' rights and temporary orders. Cases run the full range from uncontested divorces that settle quickly to mediated agreements and contested matters that go to court.

New clients start with a case evaluation, which the firm describes as free, and reviews mention same-day consultations. Intake staff gather the details first, and an attorney then explains options and next steps under Georgia law.
tips: Request a free case evaluation by phone or online
Ask whether your divorce could proceed as uncontested
Gather financial documents and custody details before your consultation

name: SPW & Associates
desc: SPW & Associates is a CPA firm on Shiloh Road providing tax, accounting and advisory services to businesses and individuals. It works with medical and dental practices, veterinarians, professional service firms, real estate professionals, assisted living and eldercare providers, and supports clients on QuickBooks Online.
tips: Use the online client center to upload documents securely
Ask about QuickBooks Desktop alternatives if your license is changing
Book tax planning meetings well before filing season
about: SPW & Associates is a CPA firm based on Shiloh Road in Alpharetta that provides tax planning and preparation, accounting, payroll and advisory work for businesses and individuals. The firm's motto sums up its pitch: you run your business, and it runs your numbers.

Much of its client base falls into a few industries. The firm works with medical and dental practices, veterinarians, professional service providers and real estate professionals, and it understands issues such as rising practice costs and shifting reimbursements. It also provides software support for owners and their staff, including QuickBooks Online help and guidance on QuickBooks Desktop pricing changes.

Beyond compliance work, SPW offers business analysis meant to help owners make decisions with clearer numbers. Clients use an online client center to share files and pay invoices, and the firm keeps weekday office hours.

name: Dhanesha & Associates
desc: Dhanesha & Associates is an Alpharetta CPA and financial planning firm on Cicero Drive serving small businesses and individuals. Services include tax planning and preparation aimed at legally reducing current and future taxes, accounting and bookkeeping, and personal financial planning.
tips: Book the free consultation to see if the firm fits your needs
Email contact@dhanesha.com to request an appointment
Ask about combining tax preparation with a broader financial plan
about: Dhanesha & Associates is a CPA and financial planning firm at 11175 Cicero Drive in Alpharetta, serving individuals and small businesses. Its team holds CPA, EA, CFP, PFS and CFA credentials along with MBAs, and several members have practiced in tax and public accounting since the early 2000s.

Services fall into three areas. Tax work covers planning and preparation aimed at keeping current and future taxes as low as the law allows. Accounting covers bookkeeping and advisory support for growing businesses. Financial planning covers retirement, investments, taxes and estate planning for households.

The firm works on a fee-only basis and offers year-round consulting rather than seasonal tax help alone. It emphasizes being easy to reach by phone, and new clients can start with a free consultation.

name: CITITAX Associates
desc: CITITAX Associates is an accounting and tax firm headquartered on Shiloh Road in Alpharetta, with a branch in Lawrenceville. It offers tax planning and preparation, small business accounting, payroll, part-time CFO services, audits and reviews, forensic accounting and personal financial and estate planning.
tips: Schedule the complimentary consultation through the toll-free line (866) 248-4829
Ask about QuickBooks setup or a tune-up for your business books
Email cpa@cititax.net with questions before your visit
about: CITITAX Associates is an accounting and tax firm on Shiloh Road in Alpharetta led by founder and managing partner Shybi Thomas, an enrolled agent with more than 20 years of experience. The firm has served the area since 2009 and also runs an office in Lawrenceville.

Services cover tax planning and preparation, bookkeeping, payroll, QuickBooks setup and training, financial analysis and part-time CFO help, along with personal financial and estate planning. The team works with established companies, entrepreneurs starting new ventures, executives and independent professionals.

The firm describes its approach as reviewing each client's full financial picture to find credits, deductions and ways to lower liabilities, then building a plan around long-term goals. It publishes a monthly newsletter and offers a free first consultation.

name: Atlanta Accounting & Taxation
desc: Atlanta Accounting & Taxation has helped small and midsize businesses with tax and accounting since 2006 from its McGinnis Ferry Road office. It sets up accounting software, files business and individual returns and provides CFO services, with service offered in English, Spanish, Russian and Mandarin.
address: 4080 McGinnis Ferry Rd, Ste 1103, Alpharetta, GA 30005
tips: Claim the free first half-hour consultation
Ask for a Saturday or evening appointment if weekdays are tight
Mention your preferred language when booking
about: Atlanta Accounting & Taxation has helped small and midsize businesses with tax and accounting since 2006. Its office is in Suite 1103 at 4080 McGinnis Ferry Road in Alpharetta, and the team serves clients in English, Spanish, Russian and Mandarin.

Core work includes monthly business accounting and tax services, accounting software setup, payroll, business and individual tax returns and CFO-level guidance. The firm also helps international companies stay compliant with U.S. tax rules, which sets it apart from many neighborhood tax offices.

Meetings can happen in the office, by phone or over video. If posted hours do not work, the staff will meet on Saturdays or evenings by appointment. New clients get their first half-hour consultation free.

name: King Insurance
desc: Independent agency for personal, business and employee benefits insurance, with an Old Milton office.
about: King Insurance now operates as King Risk Partners, a second-generation independent agency founded in 1974 by Malcolm C. King Sr. and now owned by his son. The agency has offices from New Hampshire to Florida, including two Alpharetta locations, and ranks among the top 100 brokers in the United States.

As an independent agency it is appointed with hundreds of carriers, some since the 1970s, which lets agents compare options for home, auto, business, employee benefits, aviation and surety coverage. Industry-specific commercial programs are available for businesses with unusual risks.

The Independent Insurance Agents and Brokers of America named King Risk Partners a Best Practices agency each year from 2016 through 2021, and in 2021 recognized it as the top performing Best Practices agency in its revenue class. Agents start with a consultation and then help manage coverage over time.
tips: Ask an agent to quote several carriers side by side
Bundle home and auto reviews in one consultation
Look for the King Risk Partners name, since the agency has rebranded

name: Merit Financial Advisors
desc: Merit Financial Advisors is a wealth management firm headquartered on Lakeview Parkway in Alpharetta, founded by CEO Rick Kent. It offers financial planning, investment management, tax-aware strategies, retirement and insurance planning and trust management, and has a second Alpharetta office on Rainwater Drive.
tips: Schedule an introductory consultation with an advisor
Ask about planning support during a major life transition
Sign up for the monthly market updates
about: Merit Financial Advisors is a wealth management firm founded in 1998 with an office on Lakeview Parkway in Alpharetta. CEO Rick Kent built the firm around a servant-leadership culture, and Merit now reports billions of dollars in advisory, brokerage, retirement plan and ESOP assets.

Services include financial planning, investment management, tax-aware strategies, retirement planning, insurance planning and business planning for owners. Merit puts particular focus on people in transition, such as those going through retirement, divorce, a career change or the loss of a spouse.

Its advisors act as fiduciaries, meaning they are expected to put clients' interests first. Clients also receive monthly market updates and commentary. Office hours run weekdays from 8am to 4:30pm, and new clients can start with a consultation.

name: Bluerock Wealth Management
desc: Fiduciary investment, tax, estate and college planning on Mansell Road.
about: Bluerock Wealth Management is a fee-only fiduciary practice in Suite 250 of the Mansell Two building at 3650 Mansell Road in Alpharetta. It operates as part of Hightower Advisors and is led by CEO and wealth manager Raj Chokshi, CPA, CFP.

The firm combines investing, financial planning and tax management into one plan for each client. Its investment philosophy is measured and disciplined, avoiding attempts to time the market, while year-round tax planning is treated as a core part of growing wealth.

The team includes several CFP professionals and CPAs, plus a dedicated tax director, which suits clients who want investment and tax advice under one roof. The website also publishes case studies showing how the firm has worked with clients.
tips: Read the Form CRS on the website before your first meeting
Ask how year-round tax planning fits into your investment plan
Use the map link on the site to find Suite 250 in Mansell Two

name: BIP Wealth
desc: Wealth management for high-net-worth clients, founded 2007.
address: 2500 Northwinds Pkwy, Building III, Suite 100, Alpharetta, GA 30009
about: BIP Wealth is a wealth management firm founded in 2007 by Mark Buffington and Bill Harris, CFP, who serves as CEO. Its Alpharetta office is in Building III, Suite 100, at 2500 Northwinds Parkway, and the firm also has offices in Atlanta, Columbus and Nashville.

The firm's founding idea is that wealth management should not be reserved for the ultra-wealthy. Each client works with a Personal Wealth Advisor on a financial plan, evidence-based investment strategy and help with broader money decisions. Planning areas include estate planning, Roth conversion timing, business succession and 401(k) plans for companies.

BIP serves families, professionals, business owners and retirees, and it runs a program for professional baseball players guided by former players. Affiliates offer private market investments, which the firm discloses as a conflict of interest when recommending them.
tips: Ask to be matched with a Personal Wealth Advisor
Review the disclosures on affiliated private investments
Business owners can ask about company 401(k) plans

name: Elm3 Financial Group
desc: Elm3 Financial Group is an Alpharetta financial firm near North Point that serves individuals and small businesses. It offers investment management, retirement and Social Security planning, insurance advice, estate planning, small business tax planning and preparation, management consulting and business retirement plans.
address: 5755 North Point Pkwy, Ste 92, Alpharetta, GA 30022
tips: Try the online risk tool before your first meeting
Business owners can ask about combined tax and investment planning
Browse the blog for plain-language guides on taxes and stock options
about: Elm3 Financial Group is a financial and investment advisory firm in Suite 92 at 5755 North Point Parkway in Alpharetta. Founder and principal Stacey Nickens brings a background in financial planning, investment management, tax preparation and accounting, and the team includes CPAs, enrolled agents, registered investment advisers and CFP professionals.

Services for individuals include investment management, retirement and Social Security planning, insurance evaluations and estate planning. For small businesses the firm handles tax planning and preparation, management consulting and business retirement plans.

The firm's view is that investments, insurance, taxes and business decisions all affect one another, so it tries to look at them together. Its blog covers practical topics like stock compensation and setting up an IRS payment plan.

name: WorkSmart IT
desc: Onsite and remote managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud and Microsoft 365 support.
address: 10400 Old Alabama Rd Connector, Ste 400, Alpharetta, GA 30022
about: WorkSmart IT Services is a managed IT and cybersecurity provider whose Atlanta-area team is based in Suite 400 at 10400 Old Alabama Road Connector in Alpharetta. The company also has offices in Raleigh-Durham and Charlotte and supports businesses across the East Coast.

Services include day-to-day managed IT with monitoring and help desk support, layered cybersecurity, hybrid cloud planning and migration, Microsoft 365 setup and management, and IT consulting on budgets, roadmaps and vendors. A newer AI practice helps companies find practical uses for AI and set governance rules.

Support is delivered both onsite and remotely, and the company says clients work with the same named engineers each time. It also runs educational sessions on cybersecurity, cloud and AI for growing businesses.
tips: Book a no-pressure consultation in person or online
Existing clients can reach the support center at (888) 231-4831
Ask about a cybersecurity review before renewing your IT contract

name: JJ Social Light
desc: JJ Social Light is a downtown Alpharetta digital marketing agency on Milton Avenue that serves small businesses. It offers SEO, PPC advertising, copywriting and content, social media marketing, custom and budget websites, website care plans and fractional CMO services, and is the official social media consultant of the Alpharetta Business Association.
tips: Book an introductory call to discuss your goals
Pick only the proposal items that fit your budget
Ask about a website care plan for ongoing updates
about: JJ Social Light is a digital marketing agency in downtown Alpharetta, led by Jessica Light, who describes herself as a serial online entrepreneur and project manager. The agency works with small and medium-sized businesses that want help with their online presence without managing it themselves.

Services include custom and budget websites, website care plans, local SEO, PPC and social media advertising, copywriting and content, and fractional CMO support. JJ Social Light is the official social media consultant of the Alpharetta Business Association and the Alpharetta Business Expo.

Work starts with a phone call about goals and strategy. The agency then sends a custom proposal where clients choose the pieces they need, and it shares progress during the build so owners can give input.

name: Click Medias
desc: Click Medias is a digital marketing agency, in business since 2014, that now focuses on AI search optimization so businesses appear in answers from tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity, alongside SEO and website work. It reports building more than 500 websites and lists its office in the Atlanta area.
address: 100 North Point Center East, Alpharetta, GA 30022
tips: Start with the free AI search audit
Email hello@clickmedias.com or call during weekday hours
Review generated content before approving it for publishing
about: Click Medias is a digital marketing agency that has been in business since 2014 and now centers its work on AI search optimization. The goal is to help businesses show up in answers from AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini, alongside traditional Google results.

Its platform audits a client's site, builds a strategy, and then produces blog posts, press releases and directory citations for the client to review and approve. Link building through outreach and editorial placements is included in every plan, and monthly crawls track rankings, traffic and AI visibility in a dashboard.
The company reports more than 500 active clients. Its contact page lists an Atlanta location with weekday hours, and the team says it answers inquiries within 24 hours on business days.

name: Uplink Marketing
desc: Uplink Marketing is an Alpharetta marketing engineering agency founded by Evan Chasteen in 2016. It builds and runs connected marketing systems for established businesses, combining websites, content, follow-up and reporting with AI tools, and reviews results each month against a baseline.
tips: Start with the short online application before a fit call
Review the posted pricing to confirm the budget fits
Gather your current CRM and analytics logins before kickoff
about: Uplink Marketing is an Alpharetta marketing engineering agency founded in 2016 by Evan Chasteen. It builds and operates connected marketing systems for established businesses, treating marketing like infrastructure rather than a string of separate campaigns.

Engagements can include website and landing page builds, brand and design assets, technical SEO, service and location pages, AI-assisted content edited by a person, review and referral requests, lead follow-up automation and reporting. The aim is to connect the website, CRM, email and ad accounts so leads get answered quickly and results can be measured.
Scope is set against a roadmap, and results are reviewed each month against a baseline. Posted pricing starts at $15,000 for implementation and $10,000 per month for ongoing partnerships.

name: PersistSEO
desc: Local and national SEO, web design and Google Ads since 2010.
about: PersistSEO, now operating as Persist Marketing, is a search marketing agency that has served small businesses since 2010. It lists offices in Atlanta and Alpharetta and works with clients across the metro area and beyond.

Services include local SEO, national SEO and AI search optimization, Google Ads management, website design, and review and reputation work. The agency concentrates on four groups: home service trades such as roofers and HVAC companies, law firms, health and wellness practices, and B2B companies selling nationally.

Persist focuses on owner-operated and small-team businesses and says clients talk directly with the strategists handling their accounts. Several client reviews mention working with the agency for many years.
tips: Request the free 30-minute online presence review
Expect a reply within one business day after submitting the form
Ask how local SEO and Google Ads can work together for your area

name: Wellstar Urgent Care - Atlanta Highway
desc: Walk-in urgent care open 8 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. seven days a week, with virtual care after hours.
address: 5655 Atlanta Highway, Suite A, Alpharetta, GA 30004
about: Wellstar Urgent Care on Atlanta Highway sits in Suite A at 5655 Atlanta Highway in the Crabapple side of Alpharetta. It is part of the Wellstar health system and treats patients of all ages for minor illnesses and injuries such as coughs, colds, flu, cuts, sprains, strains and simple breaks.

The clinic is open seven days a week, including weekends, from 8am to 7:30pm. You can walk in or reserve a time online, and if online slots fill up, walk-in visits are still accepted. Outside clinic hours, Wellstar offers virtual urgent care around the clock.

Other services include COVID-19 testing, imaging, sports physicals and occupational health work such as pre-employment drug screening and workers' compensation visits. For anything life-threatening, go to an emergency room or call 911 instead.
tips: Reserve a time online to shorten your wait
Use Wellstar virtual urgent care before 8am or after 7:30pm
Ask about sports physicals before school seasons start

name: Wellstar Urgent Care - Avalon Health Park
desc: Wellstar urgent care at Avalon's health park, open 8 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. daily.
address: 2450 Old Milton Pkwy, Suite 102, Alpharetta, GA 30009
about: This Wellstar Urgent Care clinic is in Suite 102 of Wellstar Avalon Health Park at 2450 Old Milton Parkway, close to the Avalon development. It treats children and adults for non-emergency problems including colds, flu, coughs, cuts, sprains, strains and minor fractures.

Compared with some urgent care sites, this one offers a broader set of imaging tests, including X-ray, ultrasound and CT scans. Sports physicals, COVID-19 testing and occupational health services such as pre-employment drug screening and workers' compensation care are also available.

Hours run 8am to 7:30pm every day of the week. Patients can walk in or book a visit time online, and walk-ins are accepted when online times are full. Wellstar's virtual urgent care covers the overnight hours.
tips: Book online ahead of time, especially on weekends
Ask whether your imaging can be done on site
Head to an ER for chest pain or other emergencies

name: Wellstar Urgent Care - Crabapple
desc: Wellstar urgent care in Crabapple, open 8 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. daily.
about: Wellstar Urgent Care in Crabapple occupies Suite 901 at 12460 Crabapple Road in north Alpharetta. Part of the Wellstar network, the clinic sees patients of every age for minor illnesses and injuries, from colds and flu to cuts, strains and small breaks.

The doors are open seven days a week from 8am to 7:30pm. Walk in, or save time by reserving an arrival time online; walk-ins are still accepted when online reservations are full. Wellstar's virtual urgent care is available 24 hours a day for problems that come up after closing.
Beyond sick visits, the clinic offers COVID-19 testing, imaging, sports physicals, and occupational health services like pre-employment drug screens and workers' compensation visits.
tips: Reserve your arrival time online before leaving home
Use Wellstar virtual urgent care overnight
Bring your insurance card and a list of current medications

name: Piedmont Urgent Care - Milton/Alpharetta
desc: Piedmont-affiliated walk-in urgent care on Highway 9.
about: Piedmont Urgent Care on Highway 9 is a walk-in clinic in the Deerfield Place shopping center, across from Cafe Lavande, just past the Deerfield Parkway intersection near the Milton and Alpharetta line. It treats patients of all ages for non-life-threatening illnesses and injuries.

The clinic is open seven days a week from 8am to 8pm, and no appointment is needed. Patients can also book ahead online or schedule a virtual visit. Services include diagnostic testing, allergy testing, COVID-19 testing, sports physicals, treatment for throat and respiratory infections and occupational health care.
From GA-400, take Exit 11 for Windward Parkway, head west, and turn right onto Highway 9. Free parking, including accessible spaces, is in front of the building.
tips: Book ahead online to save time in the waiting room
Park free in front of the building in Deerfield Place
Choose a virtual visit for minor problems you can handle from home

name: Emory at Avalon
desc: Emory primary care near Avalon offering same-day appointments, labs and women's health.
about: Emory at Avalon is an Emory Healthcare primary care office at 2795 Old Milton Parkway, near the Avalon development. Its physicians and care teams see adults and families for annual physicals, preventive care and wellness visits.

The practice also treats acute problems like infections and the flu, handles minor injuries such as sprains, and removes stitches. Ongoing care for chronic conditions such as diabetes and high blood pressure is part of the practice. Other services include same-day appointments, onsite EKGs, hospital follow-up labs, travel advice and malaria prevention, sports and pre-employment physicals, and women's health services including Pap and pelvic exams.
The office is open weekdays from 8am to 5pm and closed on weekends and major holidays, including the Thursday and Friday of Thanksgiving. Appointments are booked at 404-251-2820.
tips: Call early in the day to ask about same-day appointments
Plan travel health visits well before your trip
Check the holiday closure list before scheduling

name: Northside Alpharetta Medical Campus
desc: Northside's outpatient campus with imaging, labs, outpatient surgery and dozens of specialty practices. Note: it has no ER or urgent care.
about: Northside Alpharetta Medical Campus is a Northside Hospital outpatient campus at 3400 Old Milton Parkway, just off GA 400. Northside describes it as a 140 acre campus with more than 200 physicians, bringing together imaging, lab services, outpatient surgery and specialty practices across several buildings.

Imaging services include full-service, pediatric and women's imaging, and the campus has outpatient surgery with pre-surgical assessments. Other services include cardiovascular care, a center for perinatal medicine, diabetes education, nutritional and lactation counseling, lymphedema care, speech and audiology, a pharmacy and childbirth education classes. Physician practices cover a wide range of specialties, from family medicine and pediatrics to cardiology, dermatology, ENT, gastroenterology, neurology, OB/GYN, oncology, orthopaedics and urology.

The campus does not have an emergency room, so it is meant for scheduled visits and procedures. For emergencies, Northside directs patients to its hospitals in Atlanta or Forsyth. Departments such as radiology scheduling, lab services and pre-surgery testing have their own phone lines listed on Northside's website.
tips: Check which building your appointment is in before you arrive.
Go to an ER for emergencies, since none is on this campus.
Use the direct radiology scheduling or lab line to book imaging or tests.

name: Wellstar North Fulton Hospital
desc: Wellstar North Fulton Medical Center, formerly North Fulton Hospital, is the closest full-service hospital and ER for most of Alpharetta, just over the line in Roswell. It is a Level II Trauma Center, Level II Emergency Cardiac Care Center and Joint Commission Comprehensive Stroke Center, with a NICU and maternity care.
tips: Search for Wellstar North Fulton Medical Center in map apps
Use emergency care check-in on the Wellstar site for non-critical ER visits
Call medical records at (770) 751-2679 on weekdays
about: Wellstar North Fulton Medical Center, long known as North Fulton Hospital, is the full-service hospital closest to much of Alpharetta. It sits at 3000 Hospital Boulevard in Roswell, just south of the city line, and its emergency department is open 24 hours.

The hospital is a Level II Trauma Center, a Level II Emergency Cardiac Care Center and a Joint Commission Comprehensive Stroke Center. It is also an NAEC accredited Level 3 Comprehensive Epilepsy Center. Wellstar lists emergency check-in, imaging and a range of inpatient and specialty services for the north Fulton area.

Administrative departments such as medical records, imaging scheduling, patient billing and patient experience keep weekday hours from 8am to 5pm, each with its own phone line. The main hospital number is (770) 751-2500.

name: South Forsyth Family Medicine and Pediatrics
desc: Wellstar-affiliated practice on Lockeway Drive that combines family medicine and pediatrics under one roof, so parents and kids can see doctors in the same office. The team includes family physicians Dr. David Boaz and Dr. Mark Glodener plus pediatricians Dr. Giouzel Glodener and Dr. Jackleen Glodener.
tips: Book parent and child visits back to back to save a trip
Ask which provider is accepting new patients
Confirm insurance coverage before your first visit
about: South Forsyth Family Medicine and Pediatrics is a Wellstar-affiliated practice in Suite 404 at 1845 Lockeway Drive in Alpharetta. Family medicine and pediatrics share the same office, so parents and children can see doctors in one place.

Wellstar lists family physicians Dr. David Boaz and Dr. Mark Glodener, both affiliated with Wellstar since 2011, along with pediatricians Dr. Giouzel Glodener and Dr. Jackleen Glodener. The adult side covers primary care for parents and other adults, while the pediatricians care for infants, children and teens.

As a Wellstar affiliate, the practice fits into the larger Wellstar network for referrals, labs and hospital care. Call (770) 343-9112 to schedule or to confirm which providers are taking new patients.

name: Alpha OB/GYN
desc: Obstetrics and gynecology practice led by board-certified OB/GYN Dr. Sowmya Reddy, with an Alpharetta office on Jordan Court off Windward Parkway near GA-400 Exit 11. The practice also has a second office at Northside Hospital Forsyth in Cumming and sees women of all ages for pregnancy and gynecologic care.
address: 2905 Jordan Ct, Suite G, Alpharetta, GA 30004
tips: New patients are welcome; call (678) 335-9223
Ask which office, Alpharetta or Cumming, suits your schedule
Ask about genetic screening options early in pregnancy
about: Alpha OBGYN is the obstetrics and gynecology practice of Dr. Sowmya Reddy, a board-certified OB/GYN and diplomate of the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology. Her Alpharetta office is in Suite G on Jordan Court off Windward Parkway, and a second office operates at Northside Hospital Forsyth in Cumming.

Dr. Reddy completed her OB/GYN residency at St. John's Hospital and Medical Center in Detroit and has more than 18 years of private practice experience, including over nine years in Alpharetta, Johns Creek and Milton. The practice cares for women of all ages, from first gynecologic visits through pregnancy, and offers genetic screening options. Minimally invasive and outpatient gynecologic surgeries take place at Northside.
The practice is accepting new patients. It stresses continuity, and patients can reach Dr. Reddy by phone after office hours.

name: Preston Ridge Pediatric Associates
desc: Pediatric practice on the Northside Alpharetta Medical Campus.
address: 3400A Old Milton Pkwy, Suite 330, Alpharetta, GA 30005
about: Preston Ridge Pediatric Associates has cared for children in Alpharetta, Milton, Johns Creek, Cumming and Roswell for more than 30 years. The office is in Suite 330 at 3400A Old Milton Parkway on the Northside Alpharetta medical campus.

The practice sees patients from birth to 18 and follows American Academy of Pediatrics guidance for well visits and the AAP and CDC immunization schedule. Newborn care is a particular focus, and expectant parents can meet the team at free office tours held regularly. Sick children can usually get same-day appointments.

Parent reviews mention on-time appointments and families who have stayed with the practice for decades. Office hours run weekdays from 8am to 5pm, and an after-hours nurse line at (770) 985-7955 helps parents decide whether a child needs care right away.
tips: Sign up early for an expectant parent tour, since space is limited
Call first thing in the morning for the best choice of same-day sick visits
Save the after-hours nurse line, (770) 985-7955

name: World of Pediatrics
desc: Independent pediatric practice caring for newborns, infants, children and teens, now located on North Point Parkway. Services include well-child and sick visits, immunizations, school physicals, newborn care and chronic condition management, and it serves families from Alpharetta, Johns Creek, Milton, Roswell, Cumming and nearby areas.
address: 3255 North Point Pkwy, Suite 102, Alpharetta, GA 30005
tips: Book your newborn's first visit before or right after delivery
Use the patient portal for appointments and billing
Bring your child's vaccination records, since the practice requires mandated vaccines
about: The World of Pediatrics is an independent pediatric practice that has served north Fulton, Forsyth and Cherokee county families since 1989. Its office is now in Suite 102 at 3255 North Point Parkway in Alpharetta, and its board-certified pediatricians care for newborns through teens.

Services include well-child checkups, vaccinations, same-day sick visits and newborn care. After a baby comes home from the hospital, the office sees the newborn within 24 to 48 business hours for a full exam, weight check, feeding review, jaundice check and umbilical cord care. The team also supports children's mental health alongside physical care.

The practice requires mandated vaccinations for all patients to protect infants too young to be fully vaccinated, and it accepts private network insurance. A patient portal handles messages, appointments and billing.

name: North Point Pediatrics
desc: General pediatric practice in Suite 410 at 3180 North Point Parkway, in the office corridor near North Point Mall. It provides routine well visits, sick care and vaccinations for infants, children and teens from Alpharetta and nearby north Fulton communities.
address: 3180 North Point Pkwy, Suite 410, Building 400, Alpharetta, GA 30005
tips: Call as early as possible in the day to get a same-day sick appointment.
Book well checks several months ahead, since scheduling opens up to a year out.
Fill out new patient forms from the website before your first visit.
about: North Point Pediatrics is a general pediatric practice in Suite 410 of Building 400 at 3180 North Point Parkway, in the medical office corridor near North Point Mall. Founded in 1998, it cares for children from infancy through adolescence, and the practice says every provider on its team is board certified.

Services include well-child checkups, same-day sick visits, immunizations that follow American Academy of Pediatrics guidelines, sports and school physicals, and evaluation and follow-up care for ADD and ADHD. The office also offers ear piercing in a private, sterile setting.

Families can use a patient portal and pay bills online. Sick children wait in a separate sick waiting room, well checks can be booked up to a year in advance, and the practice asks parents of newborns to call after hospital discharge so the baby can be seen within about 48 hours. The building has ample free parking and easy access to Children's Healthcare of Atlanta outpatient services.

name: Roswell Pediatric Center - Alpharetta
desc: Longtime pediatric group with an Alpharetta office in Suite 200 on Haynes Bridge Road, despite the Roswell name. The practice also runs offices in Crabapple and Cumming, and its pediatricians and nurse practitioners rotate through Saturday morning sick visits held only at this Alpharetta location.
address: 11525 Haynes Bridge Rd, Suite 200, Alpharetta, GA 30009
tips: Saturday morning sick visits are offered only at this office
Call between 8:30am and 4:30pm on weekdays to schedule
Watch the online office tour before your first visit
about: Despite its name, Roswell Pediatric Center runs a full office in Alpharetta, in Suite 200 at 11525 Haynes Bridge Road. The group also has offices on Crabapple Road and in Cumming, and all of its pediatricians are board certified in caring for infants, children and adolescents.

Nationally certified nurse practitioners work alongside the physicians on routine sick and well care, and they share after-hours on-call duty. The practice's motto is "Your Child Is Special," and families can view a video tour of each office on the website.

This Alpharetta office is the group's only location with Saturday hours. Providers rotate through Saturday morning sick appointments from 8 to 11:30am, while weekday phone lines are open 8:30am to 4:30pm.

name: Harmony Pediatrics
desc: Direct primary care pediatric practice led by Dr. Shefali Chheda. Families pay a membership instead of co-pays or insurance billing, and in return get direct access to the pediatrician, including after-hours contact, for routine and sick care.
tips: Ask about membership terms before enrolling
Call 770-475-9924 or use the website form to book a consultation
Use direct texting for quick questions between visits
about: Harmony Pediatrics is a membership-based pediatric practice at 1800 Abbey Court in Alpharetta led by Dr. Shefali Chheda. Instead of billing visits through insurance, families pay a membership and get unlimited visits with no co-pays or deductibles.

Members receive Dr. Chheda's cell number and can text her directly, with 24/7 access to the practice's board-certified pediatricians. Appointments run longer than at a typical office, same-day sick visits are offered, and home visits are available when needed.

The practice takes an integrative approach that pairs evidence-based medicine with other modalities. It offers nutrition guidance and gut microbiome testing. Its site notes that the model differs from concierge medicine, which often charges more.

name: Awbrey Orthodontics
desc: Orthodontic practice on Windward Parkway.
about: Awbrey Orthodontics is the Windward Parkway practice of Dr. Jim Awbrey, an Atlanta native who has been straightening teeth for more than 30 years. The office is in Suite 200 at 4895 Windward Parkway and treats children, teens and adults.

Treatment options include traditional braces, Invisalign clear aligners and Smile Express, a shorter aligner program aimed at adults who want cosmetic changes with fewer office visits. Most patients finish with clear retainers, thin trays similar to aligners. For younger kids, the practice offers early growth monitoring between ages 7 and 10 to catch problems early.

Reviews describe a warm office and a treatment coordinator who walks families through the details before treatment starts. New patients can book a complimentary consultation. Office hours run Monday through Thursday, with a short Friday morning schedule.
tips: Book a complimentary consultation with Dr. Awbrey
Bring children ages 7 to 10 in for early growth monitoring
Ask whether Smile Express fits a minor adult correction

name: STABLE Orthodontics
desc: Orthodontic practice on Broadwell Road in Crabapple.
about: STABLE Orthodontics is an independently owned practice in Suite 100 at 12455 Broadwell Road in Crabapple, with a second office in Canton. Dr. Korry Tauber is the only orthodontist and sees every patient himself at both locations. He grew up in north Georgia, graduated from South Forsyth High School and is a board-certified Diplomate of the American Board of Orthodontics.

The practice offers braces, Invisalign and adult orthodontics, and airway-focused care is one of its most requested services. Dr. Tauber evaluates breathing issues like snoring along with the bite and may recommend palatal expansion.

Every patient gets a digital scan instead of impressions, plus a 3D X-ray and an outcome simulation. Appliances and retainers are made on an in-house 3D printer. The team aims to explain pricing clearly from the first call, and a complimentary consultation includes an office tour and meet-and-greet.
tips: Schedule the complimentary consultation and office tour
Ask about airway screening if your child snores
Children can start free checkups from age 7

name: Brooks Orthodontic Studio
desc: Orthodontic studio in the North Point corridor.
address: 3180 North Point Pkwy, Suite 521, Alpharetta, GA 30005
about: Brooks Orthodontic Studio is a family-owned orthodontic practice in Suite 521 at 3180 North Point Parkway in Alpharetta. Board-certified orthodontist Dr. Bridgette Brooks leads the practice and treats patients of all ages.

The studio is built around efficient treatment plans for busy families and professionals. Technology includes iTero digital scanning, custom braces and 3D-printed appliances. Braces come in metal, clear and champagne options, and Dr. Brooks is a certified Invisalign provider. Early evaluations for children aim to address issues before they become complex, and retainers help hold results after treatment.
New patients can schedule a free consultation, where Dr. Brooks assesses the case personally and explains the options. The office keeps weekday hours, with a slightly later start on Thursdays.
tips: Book a free consultation with Dr. Brooks
Ask about champagne or clear braces if you want a subtler look
Bring younger children in for an early orthodontic check

name: Newpark Orthodontics
desc: Orthodontic practice on Old Milton Parkway.
address: 4190 Old Milton Pkwy, Suite 2i, Alpharetta, GA 30005
about: Newpark Orthodontics is an orthodontic practice in Suite 2i at 4190 Old Milton Parkway in Alpharetta, led by Dr. Nima Hajibaik, known to patients as Dr. Nima. It serves families from Alpharetta, Johns Creek, Roswell and Cumming.

Treatment options include traditional braces, clear braces and Invisalign for children, teens and adults. The practice also offers early treatment to guide young smiles, care for complex bite and jaw problems, and retainers to protect results. Patients can join a Lifetime Retainer Program.

Dr. Nima is a member of the Roth-Williams International Society of Orthodontists, the American Association of Orthodontists, the Southern Association of Orthodontists and the American Dental Association. The practice reports helping more than 1,000 patients, and reviews often mention a clean, modern office. Hours run weekdays from 8am to 5pm.
tips: Ask about the Lifetime Retainer Program
Take the online office tour before your first visit
Schedule an early evaluation for younger children

name: Jordan Orthodontics
desc: Orthodontic practice on North Point Parkway.
about: Jordan Orthodontics has been creating smiles in Alpharetta since 1988 from its office at 4205 North Point Parkway. Dr. Jeff Jordan graduated from the University of Georgia, earned his DMD from the Medical College of Georgia and completed his orthodontic training at St. Louis University. He is a board-certified Diplomate of the American Board of Orthodontics.

The practice treats patients at every stage of life. Options include traditional braces, clear braces, Invisalign aligners, Smile Express for faster adult aligner treatment, and early growth monitoring for children.

Because the practice has been in the same community for decades, some reviewers say Dr. Jordan treated them as kids and now treats their own children. New patients can book a free consultation to discuss treatment length, options and cost.
tips: Book a free consultation to compare braces and Invisalign
Ask about Smile Express for a shorter adult treatment
Bring children in early for growth monitoring

name: Quality Orthodontic Care
desc: Orthodontic practice on Old Milton Parkway offering braces and Invisalign for children, teens and adults. It also provides early Phase One treatment, retainers, mouthguards, jaw surgery coordination and TMD care, and uses 3D smile simulation and digital scanning.
tips: Book the free consultation
Schedule a first check for children around age 7
Ask how supervised Invisalign compares with mail-order aligners
about: Quality Orthodontic Care is an orthodontic practice at 2455 Old Milton Parkway in Alpharetta led by Dr. John Fleming, who grew up in rural Kentucky as the son of schoolteachers before moving to Atlanta. Dr. Wes Fleming is also part of the team.

The practice treats children, teens and adults with braces and Invisalign. It holds Invisalign's Diamond Plus designation and was nationally recognized in 2014 for reaching Invisalign's highest tier. Following American Association of Orthodontists guidance, it encourages a first orthodontic check around age 7 and offers Phase One early treatment to guide jaw growth. Other services include retainers, mouthguards, jaw surgery coordination and TMD care.
The team emphasizes patient education, including how in-office Invisalign differs from mail-order aligners. First consultations are free.

name: Avalon Pediatric Dentistry
desc: Children's dental practice on Preston Ridge Road.
address: 3480 Preston Ridge Rd, Suite 125, Alpharetta, GA 30005
about: Avalon Pediatric Dentistry & Sedation Center is a children's dental practice in Suite 125 at 3480 Preston Ridge Road in Alpharetta, close to Old Milton Parkway and the Avalon area. It provides care for children from the time the first tooth comes in through the college years.

Services listed by the practice include preventive and restorative care, a Healthy Start program, orthodontics, Invisalign and retainers, tongue-tie treatment with laser frenectomy, and myofunctional therapy. For apprehensive children, very young children and children with special needs, it offers in-office IV sedation, with an anesthesiologist giving and monitoring the sedation while the dentist works. Anesthesia fees are billed separately from dental insurance.

The practice is led by Dr. Sarah Chang, a graduate of New York University and NYU's College of Dentistry who completed a pediatric residency at St. Barnabas Hospital in the Bronx, where she served as chief resident. New patients can download a registration form from the website and send it in ahead of the first visit.
tips: Fill out the new patient form online before your first visit.
Ask how anesthesia fees work if sedation is recommended.
Schedule Friday visits early since the office closes at 2pm.

name: Halcyon Pediatric Dentistry
desc: Children's dental practice on McGinnis Ferry Road.
address: 4080 McGinnis Ferry Rd, Ste 201, Alpharetta, GA 30005
about: Halcyon Pediatric Dentistry is a children's dental practice in Suite 201 at 4080 McGinnis Ferry Road in Alpharetta, near the Johns Creek and Forsyth county line. It focuses on dental care for children and teens and describes its services as board certified pediatric dentistry and orthodontic care.

Services listed on the practice website include preventive and restorative dentistry, orthodontic treatment and individualized treatment plans. A distinctive part of the practice is airway care: Dr. Sarah Chang screens for signs of deficient growth and development and for sleep-related breathing problems such as snoring and sleep apnea, which the practice links to oral development.

The office uses 3D cone beam CT imaging, an iTero scanner for Invisalign and a laser for soft tissue procedures. Its website notes that visits are by appointment, and the listed hours run Monday through Thursday. Call to confirm insurance, referral requirements and new patient availability.
tips: Plan visits Monday through Thursday.
Mention snoring or restless sleep so the dentist can screen for airway issues.
Call ahead to confirm insurance coverage and referral requirements.

name: Mini Molars Pediatric Dentistry

hours: Mon, Tue, Thu 8am-4pm; Wed and Fri closed

Plan around the Wednesday and Friday closures
about: Mini Molars Pediatric Dentistry is a children's dental office in Suite 240 at 8420 Holcomb Bridge Road, near the Alpharetta and Roswell line. It is led by Dr. Abbey Elson, a board-certified pediatric dentist and Diplomate of the American Board of Pediatric Dentistry who grew up in St. Louis.

The practice covers exams and cleanings, restorative care, extractions, emergency visits and sedation. Dr. Elson has a particular focus on children with special needs, and the team encourages parents to share any sensitivities or fears ahead of time so the visit can be adjusted.

Families are welcome to stop by before booking to look around and meet the staff. The office is accepting new patients and describes itself as insurance friendly. It is open Monday, Tuesday and Thursday from 8am to 4pm and closed Wednesday and Friday.

name: Atlanta Center for Dermatologic Disease
desc: Dermatology group with an Alpharetta office in Building C of the 3400 Old Milton Parkway medical campus, plus offices elsewhere in metro Atlanta including Roswell, Cumming and Sandy Springs. It provides medical dermatology for skin, hair and nail conditions along with skin checks for adults and children.
address: 3400 Old Milton Pkwy, Building C, Suite 340, Alpharetta, GA 30005

Bring a list of spots or symptoms you want checked.
about: Atlanta Center for Dermatologic Diseases is a dermatology group with an office in Suite 340 of Building C on the 3400 Old Milton Parkway medical campus in Alpharetta. The practice has served patients for more than 30 years and also has offices in Roswell, Cumming and Sandy Springs.

It provides dermatology care for adults and children, covering skin, hair and nail conditions such as acne, eczema, psoriasis, rosacea, warts and rashes, along with skin checks and skin cancer treatment. Cosmetic services include dermal fillers, cheek enhancement and dermaplaning. The physician team includes Dr. David Levine, Dr. Martin Weil, Dr. Kenneth Ellner, Dr. Kevin Berman and several other dermatologists, working alongside physician assistants.

Appointments can be requested through the practice website or by calling the Alpharetta office. Since the group has four offices, ask which providers see patients in Alpharetta, and review the insurance information on the website before your visit.

name: Windward Eye Care
desc: Locally owned optometry office opened in 2003 by Drs. Thomas Arey, Sean Alexander and Michael Walker, operating with sister office Alpharetta Eye Clinic under Atlanta Eye Care. It offers adult and children's eye exams, contact lenses, eyeglasses and sunglasses, plus LASIK and cataract consultations.
address: 5315 Windward Pkwy, Suite F, Alpharetta, GA 30004
tips: Request an appointment through the online form
Ask about a LASIK candidacy evaluation
Use Saturday hours if weekdays are hard to fit in
about: Windward Eye Care is an optometry office on Windward Parkway across from Home Depot, in Suite F at 5315 Windward Parkway. It has served north Fulton since 2003 and works with sister office Alpharetta Eye Clinic under the Atlanta Eye Care name. Optometrists include Dr. Thomas Arey, Dr. Sean Alexander and Dr. Michael Walker.

The practice sees children, adults and seniors for comprehensive eye exams and for diagnosis and management of eye diseases. It fits specialty contact lenses, including bifocal lenses for presbyopia, and sells eyeglasses and prescription sunglasses.

Patients considering LASIK or PRK can get pre-operative evaluations and follow-up care, and the doctors provide cataract diagnosis, surgical referrals and care before and after surgery. Saturday hours are offered at this Windward office.

name: Eye Associates of North Atlanta
desc: Private ophthalmology practice of board-certified ophthalmologist and cataract surgeon Dr. Anand K. Shah, located near North Point Mall between GA-400 exits 9 and 10. Services include eye exams, cataract surgery, glaucoma, diabetic eye exams, dry eye and macular degeneration care.
address: 5755 North Point Pkwy, Suite 94, Alpharetta, GA 30022
tips: Request an appointment online, or call the general line at 470-767-8287
Ask about the self-pay flat rate if you are between insurance plans
Ask about evening or weekend openings
about: Eye Associates of North Atlanta is the private ophthalmology practice of Dr. Anand K. Shah, a board-certified ophthalmologist and cataract surgeon with more than a decade of medical experience. The office is in Suite 94 at 5755 North Point Parkway, near North Point Mall between GA-400 exits 9 and 10.

The practice provides medical and surgical eye care for adults, including comprehensive eye exams, cataract surgery and care for glaucoma, diabetic eye disease, dry eye and macular degeneration. Dr. Shah performs each comprehensive exam himself and explains the results, and reviews often describe him as thorough.

Office hours run Monday through Friday from 9am to 5pm, with some evening and weekend times based on availability. The practice accepts most major insurance plans and offers a flat rate for self-pay patients.

name: Atlanta Institute for ENT
desc: Northside network ear, nose and throat practice with an Alpharetta office in Suite 520 at 3333 Old Milton Parkway, near GA-400 Exit 10, and a second office in Atlanta. Board-certified ENT physicians and audiologists see adults and children for sinus and nasal issues, allergies, sleep and snoring, voice and swallowing, and hearing.
address: 3333 Old Milton Pkwy, Suite 520, Alpharetta, GA 30005
tips: Use GA-400 Exit 10 and turn in at the second light
Ask for a hearing test with an audiologist if needed
Review provider bios online before choosing a doctor
about: Atlanta Institute for ENT is an ear, nose and throat practice in the Northside Hospital network with an Alpharetta office in Suite 520 at 3333 Old Milton Parkway. From GA-400, take Exit 10 and head east about half a mile to the second light, then turn right into the building entrance.

Its physicians treat adults and children for sinus and nasal problems, allergies, sleep and snoring issues, voice and swallowing concerns and ear conditions. Pediatric otolaryngology is among the listed specialties, and audiologists are part of the team for hearing evaluations.

The practice's website includes background on each doctor's training and interests so patients know who they will see before a consultation. Call the office to make an appointment, or ask your doctor to send a referral.

name: Northside ENT Specialists
desc: Northside Hospital ear, nose and throat office in Suite 240 on Preston Ridge Road near Old Milton Parkway. Providers include Dr. Ronald Alvarez, who also practices sleep medicine, Dr. Daniel Carothers and physician assistant Sajani Patel, treating adult and pediatric ENT conditions.
address: 3330 Preston Ridge Rd, Suite 240, Alpharetta, GA 30005
tips: Look for Suite 240 at 3330 Preston Ridge Rd.
Check Northside's provider pages to pick a doctor.
Ask whether a referral is needed for your insurance.
about: Northside ENT Specialists is a Northside Hospital ear, nose and throat office in Suite 240 at 3330 Preston Ridge Road, near Old Milton Parkway. It is one of the specialty practices run by the Northside Hospital system, which operates hospitals and physician offices across metro Atlanta.

The office is staffed by Dr. Ronald J. Alvarez, who practices both otolaryngology and sleep medicine, Dr. Daniel Gordon Carothers, an otolaryngologist, and physician assistant Sajani Patel. Otolaryngology covers conditions of the ears, nose, sinuses, throat, voice and swallowing, and the head and neck, and the office sees both adult and pediatric patients.

The office sits among other medical buildings on Preston Ridge Road, a short drive from GA 400. Northside's website has provider profiles that can help you choose a doctor, and calling ahead lets you confirm hours and insurance.

name: Pediatric ENT of Atlanta
desc: Pediatric ear, nose and throat practice in Suite 275 at 3300 Old Milton Parkway, focused on infants, children and teens. Physicians listed for this office include pediatric otolaryngologists Dr. Erik Bauer and Dr. Megan Ballard and otolaryngologist Dr. Paula Harmon.
address: 3300 Old Milton Pkwy, Suite 275, Alpharetta, GA 30005
tips: Look for Suite 275 at 3300 Old Milton Pkwy.
Ask your pediatrician about a referral first.
Write down your child's symptoms and history before the visit.
about: Pediatric ENT of Atlanta is an ear, nose and throat practice for infants, children and teens, with an Alpharetta office in Suite 275 at 3300 Old Milton Parkway. The practice is a Wellstar affiliate, and the office sits in the medical corridor along Old Milton Parkway near GA 400.

Wellstar's location page lists pediatric otolaryngologists Dr. Erik Bauer, affiliated with Wellstar since 2013, and Dr. Megan Ballard, affiliated since 2024, along with otolaryngologist Dr. Paula Harmon, who holds both DMD and MD degrees and has been affiliated since 2019. Families typically see a pediatric ENT for concerns involving the ears, nose, sinuses and throat, such as recurring ear infections, tonsils and adenoids, or breathing and hearing questions.

Many families arrive through a pediatrician referral, so check whether your insurance requires one before calling. Wellstar's page also provides guidance on appointments and cancellations, directions and insurance for the visit.

name: Northside Orthopedics - Sports Medicine
desc: Northside Hospital Orthopedics sports medicine office in Building C on the Old Milton Parkway campus.
