In 2018 the team moved from North Point to a boutique space on Webb Bridge Way, and in 2019 the salon rebranded as Brash. The stylists have taught and demonstrated internationally and have won photographic awards.

Services include wash, cut and blowdry, updos, color, highlights, ombre and balayage, fashion color and Coppola keratin smoothing, which requires a consultation. Pricing is tiered by stylist level, from designer to senior creative director. Walk-ins are welcome and consultations are complimentary. The salon is open seven days except Tuesday.
tips: The salon is closed Tuesdays but open Sunday afternoons.
Ask for a free consultation before color or keratin work to get an accurate quote.
If you booked online before, you may need to create a new account on the current booking portal.
hours: Mon 10am-6pm; Tue closed; Wed-Thu 10am-6pm; Fri 11am-7pm; Sat 9am-6pm; Sun 11am-6pm

name: Milton Salon & Barber Shop
desc: Walk-in friendly barber shop and hair salon in the Old Milton Festival plaza, open seven days, with fades, hot towel shaves, kids' cuts and smoothing treatments.
about: Milton Salon & Barber Shop was opened in October 2017 by Gus Bukhari, who has been cutting hair since 1990 and still works the chair. It sits in the Old Milton Festival plaza, two minutes from GA 400 Exit 10, across Old Milton Parkway from Georgia State University's Alpharetta campus. Look for the red sign over the green awning.

The shop is one room, with barber chairs on one side and a salon on the other. Barbers handle classic cuts, skin and taper fades, gray blending, beard line-ups and straight razor hot towel shaves, while the salon side offers women's cuts and blowouts, color, Brazilian Blowout smoothing and Japanese straightening.

Walk-ins are taken every day, including Sunday, and appointments can be booked online through Fresha. Kids are welcome and first haircuts are common. The full price list is posted on the website, and parking is free right outside the door.
tips: Walk in any day, but book ahead on weekends since they fill up.
You can text the shop at the main number with quick questions.
Salon treatments like smoothing start with a free consultation to confirm the price.
address: 3710 Old Milton Pkwy, Suite 104, Alpharetta, GA 30005

name: Tonsorial Barber Shop
desc: Private, upscale gentlemen's grooming parlor on Windward Parkway founded in 2021 by third-generation barber Luis Morales, offering haircuts and shave services.
about: Tonsorial Barber Shop is a private, upscale grooming parlor for men on Windward Parkway. Founder Luis Morales opened it in 2021 after working at top barbershops around Atlanta, and he comes from a family of barbers and hairdressers. His grandfather owned five shops in Mexico, and Luis is the third generation in the trade.

The shop focuses on men's haircutting, blending old school techniques with modern ones, and offers both hair and shave services. The team stays current on industry standards, and the shop describes its goal as creating an experience rather than simply a service.

Appointments are booked online through the website. The shop is in Suite 204 at 5815 Windward Parkway, so it is convenient for people working in the Windward office corridor, and it opens at 8:30am on weekdays for a cut before work.
tips: Book through the website's Book Now link before you go.
Weekday hours start at 8:30am, which works for a pre-work cut.
The shop is closed on Sundays.

name: Lux Barbershop
desc: North Main Street barbershop pairing classic barber chairs with modern style, offering haircuts, fades, straight razor hot towel shaves, beard trims and add-ons.
about: Lux Barbershop on North Main Street blends traditional men's grooming with a modern setting, from authentic barber chairs to hot towel shaves with a straight edge razor. The owner learned the trade from his brother, opened his first shop at 23, and founded Lux after ten years of cutting hair in Alpharetta.

Haircuts range from classic styles to modern fades, with options for long hair and father and son appointments. Shave and beard services include precision shaves, beard trims, hot towels and razor detailing. Add-ons include hair coloring, facials, waxing and shampoo service.

The shop is open seven days a week, including Sunday mornings and afternoons, and appointments are booked through the website. It is in Suite 104 at 631 North Main Street, north of downtown Alpharetta.
tips: Ask about father and son appointments if you are bringing a child.
Saturday opens at 8am for early cuts.
Book online through the website's Make Appointment link.
address: 631 N Main St, Suite 104, Alpharetta, GA 30009

name: Al's Alpharetta Barber Shop
desc: Classic downtown Alpharetta barber shop on Commerce Street with over 25 years of experience, offering men's haircuts, fades, beard trims and hot towel shaves.
about: Al's Alpharetta Barber Shop is a classic men's barbershop on Commerce Street in downtown Alpharetta, near City Center and a short drive from Avalon. The shop cites more than 25 years of experience serving the community and moved into its current modern space in March 2019.

The barbers specialize in classic men's haircuts, precision fades, beard trims, hot towel shaves and straight razor shaves. The shop's stated focus is building long term relationships with clients through quality cuts and easy conversation, and its motto is to come as you are and leave looking your best.

Walk-ins are welcome and appointments can be booked online through Vagaro. The shop is open seven days a week, including Sunday, which makes it easy to fit in a cut before or after work or during a lunch break downtown.
tips: Walk-ins are welcome, but booking online through Vagaro avoids a wait.
Open Sundays 10am to 5pm.
The downtown Commerce Street location is a short walk from City Center.

name: Gentlemen's Hair Quarters
desc: Family-owned Alpharetta barber shop for 15+ years on Atlanta Highway, with master barbers for fades, scissor cuts, kids' cuts, beard trims and hot towel shaves.
about: Gentlemen's Hair Quarters is a family-owned barber shop that has operated in Alpharetta for more than 15 years, located on Atlanta Highway. Its master barbers work with all hair types and textures, and every service starts with a short consultation so the cut fits the client.

Services include fades and tapers, precision scissor cuts with wash and style, classic gentleman cuts, kids' cuts including first haircuts, beard trims and lineups, straight razor hot towel shaves, style consultations and hair health advice on products and care.

Walk-ins are welcome, though appointments are recommended to secure a preferred time. The shop asks clients to call for current prices and to ask about kids and student pricing. There is plenty of parking in the lot, and the shop serves customers from Alpharetta, Johns Creek, Roswell and nearby areas.
tips: Ask about kids and student pricing when you call.
Saturday hours end at 3pm, so book early in the day.
Appointments are recommended to avoid a wait, though walk-ins are accepted.

name: Sev Skin Alpharetta
desc: Laser hair removal and aesthetics studio in Stone Walk at North Point offering laser facials, SkinPen microneedling and cosmetic injections, with pricing posted online.
about: Sev Skin Alpharetta is part of a national chain of laser hair removal and skin care studios, located in the Stone Walk at North Point shopping center at Haynes Bridge Road and North Point Parkway, near North Point Mall.

The studio offers laser hair removal using dual wavelength Alexandrite and Nd:YAG lasers, which the company says are suited to all skin tones and types. Other services include a quick laser facial, SkinPen microneedling, and cosmetic injections such as Xeomin, Botox and Juvederm. Most appointments are short, and many treatments are listed as having no recovery time.

Sev Skin publishes its pricing on its website before you book and offers single sessions, packages and membership plans. Intro offers are available to clients new to a service on select treatment areas. Appointments can be booked online or by phone, and the studio is closed on Sundays.
tips: Check the website for current intro offers if you are new to a service.
Pricing is listed online, so compare single sessions with membership plans before booking.
The studio is in Stone Walk at North Point, near North Point Mall.

name: dermani MEDSPA Alpharetta
desc: North Point Parkway location of the dermani MEDSPA chain, offering Botox and Juvederm, laser hair removal, Hydrafacial, SkinPen microneedling, peels and facials.
about: dermani MEDSPA Alpharetta is a location of a multi-state med spa franchise, set on North Point Parkway. The brand offers memberships, free consultations and posted everyday pricing, and new clients can check the specials page for first visit offers.

Services fall into a few groups. Cosmetic injectables include Botox Cosmetic and Juvederm fillers. Laser hair removal covers small, medium and large areas, with an unlimited one hour option. Skin rejuvenation includes chemical peels, microdermabrasion, medical grade facials, IPL photofacials and dermaplaning, and the menu also lists Hydrafacial, DiamondGlow, SkinPen microneedling and CoolSculpting.

The Alpharetta location reports that it completed thousands of appointments in 2025, including more than 1,000 free consultations. It is open weekdays and Saturdays and closes briefly midday for lunch, so plan around that window when booking.
tips: Book a free consultation first to build a treatment plan.
The spa closes from 1:30pm to 2:15pm on weekdays for lunch.
Look at the specials page for new client offers before your first visit.
hours: Mon-Fri 9am-7pm (closed 1:30pm-2:15pm for lunch); Sat 9am-5pm; Sun closed

name: European Wax Center Alpharetta
desc: Old Milton Parkway location of European Wax Center, offering face and body waxing for women and men, brow waxing and tinting, plus Wax Pass packages.
about: European Wax Center Alpharetta is a location of the national waxing chain, on Old Milton Parkway near Avalon. The center focuses on hair removal for women and men, with services covering the brows, face, underarms, arms, legs, back, chest and bikini areas, including Brazilian waxing.

Facial services include brow waxing and brow tinting, lip, chin, cheek, nose, ear and full face waxing. Men's waxing has its own menu. Pricing for each service is listed on the location page, and the center offers Wax Pass packages that lower the per visit cost for regular clients, along with a new guest offer available in the center.

The brand publishes first visit guidance, prep tips and aftercare advice on its website, which is useful for anyone new to waxing. The center is open seven days a week with evening hours until 8pm on weekdays, and appointments can be booked online.
tips: Read the first visit and prep guidance on the website before your appointment.
Ask about a Wax Pass if you plan to come in regularly.
Weekday evenings run until 8pm, which helps after work.

name: The Waxed Tulip
desc: By-appointment waxing and sugaring studio inside My Salon Suites on Haynes Bridge Road, also offering dermaplaning facials in a private suite setting.
about: The Waxed Tulip is a small hair removal studio that works by appointment from a private suite inside My Salon Suites on Haynes Bridge Road. It offers waxing, sugaring and dermaplaning, with one on one service in a quiet room.

Sugaring uses a paste made from lemon, water and sugar that is applied against the direction of hair growth and removed with it. The studio notes it can take shorter, finer hair than waxing and only removes the dead skin layer. For both waxing and sugaring, it recommends growing hair to about a quarter inch, which usually takes 10 to 14 days.

Dermaplaning uses a blade to remove dead skin and fine facial hair, and the studio says there is no downtime. Services and pricing are listed on the website. Appointments are available Tuesday through Friday, and you can book online or reach out through the contact form, email or phone.
tips: Let hair grow to about a quarter inch before waxing or sugaring.
Open Tuesday through Friday only, by appointment.
The studio is in Suite 205 inside My Salon Suites at 11800 Haynes Bridge Rd.
address: 11800 Haynes Bridge Rd, #1, Suite 205, Alpharetta, GA 30009
hours: By appointment: Tue 10am-4pm; Wed-Thu 10am-5pm; Fri 10am-4pm; Sat-Mon closed

name: Lux Nail Lounge at Avalon
desc: Nail salon at Avalon offering manicures, pedicures, acrylic and gel enhancements, nail art, waxing, lash extensions and powder brow shading, open seven days.
about: Lux Nail Lounge at Avalon is a nail salon on Avalon Boulevard, inside the Avalon shopping and dining district. It aims for an upscale, welcoming setting and keeps evening hours most days.

The core menu covers manicures and pedicures, plus nail enhancements such as acrylics, gels and nail art. Beyond nails, the salon offers waxing from brows to legs, semi-permanent eyelash extensions, and permanent shading, a cosmetic tattooing technique also known as ombre or powder brows. The website also lists massage on its services menu.

Appointments can be booked online, and the salon is open seven days a week, until 8pm on weekdays. Its Avalon location makes it easy to pair a nail appointment with shopping or a meal nearby. The salon posts updates and promotions on its social channels, and the website notes when specials are available.
tips: Book online to secure a time, especially on weekends at Avalon.
Weekday hours run until 8pm.
Ask about lash extensions or powder brows if you want to bundle services.

name: Epiphany Dermatology - Alpharetta
desc: General, surgical and cosmetic dermatology office in Building C of the Northside Alpharetta medical campus, offering skin cancer screenings, biopsies, mole removal, acne care and cosmetic treatments.
about: Epiphany Dermatology of Alpharetta is the local office of a multi-state dermatology group, located in Building C of the Northside Alpharetta medical campus off Old Milton Parkway. The practice covers general dermatology, skin cancer care and cosmetic dermatology for patients of all ages.

The provider team includes board-certified dermatologists Dr. Corinne Smith, who has treated patients in and around Alpharetta since 1999, and Dr. Tiffany Clay-Ramsey, along with Dr. Kehinde Raji Olumesi, a fellowship-trained Mohs and cosmetic dermatologic surgeon. Common visits include annual skin checks, biopsies, mole removal, acne, psoriasis, hair loss, fungal infections and treatment of precancerous spots.

The office recently moved into Suite 575, right next door to its former suite. From GA 400, take exit 10 to Old Milton Parkway, turn onto Morris Road, then Preston Ridge Road, and use the parking garage across from Building C.
tips: The office is now in Suite 575 of Building C, next door to the old suite
Park in the garage on the left as you face Building C
Patient forms can be downloaded from the location page before your visit
address: 3400 Old Milton Pkwy, Building C, Suite 575, Alpharetta, GA 30005

name: Premier Dermatology and Mohs Surgery of Atlanta
desc: North Point Parkway dermatology practice led by a fellowship-trained Mohs surgeon, focused on skin cancer treatment, medical dermatology, vein care and cosmetic injectables.
about: Premier Dermatology and Mohs Surgery of Atlanta is a dermatology practice on North Point Parkway in Alpharetta. It is led by Dr. Brent Taylor, a board-certified dermatologist and fellowship-trained Mohs surgeon who is also board certified in phlebology. He trained in Mohs and procedural dermatology at Scripps Clinic in La Jolla, California, after residency at the Medical University of South Carolina.

The practice centers on skin cancer: screenings, treatment of basal cell and squamous cell carcinoma and melanoma, Mohs micrographic surgery, surgical excision and photodynamic therapy. It also treats general skin conditions and offers vein care for spider veins and chronic venous insufficiency, plus cosmetic options such as Botox, Kybella and fillers. Kathryn Filipek, PA-C, is also on the team.
The office is in Suite 420 at 3180 North Point Parkway, a short drive from GA 400 and North Point Mall. Early 7am openings run Monday through Wednesday.
tips: Early 7am appointments are offered Monday through Wednesday
The office is closed on Fridays
Vein evaluations for spider veins are offered alongside skin cancer care
address: 3180 North Point Pkwy, Suite 420, Alpharetta, GA 30005

name: Spectrum Dermatology of Atlanta
desc: Windward Concourse dermatology practice founded by two board-certified dermatologists, offering medical, skin cancer, cosmetic and aesthetic care for children and adults.
about: Spectrum Dermatology of Atlanta opened in Alpharetta in 2021 in The Park at Windward Concourse office park. It was founded by board-certified dermatologists Dr. Susan Spitzler and Dr. Emma Murad, both trained at Emory, and the practice lists itself as a member of the Emory Healthcare Network.

Kids ages 7 to 12 train at 5:15pm on weekdays.
Friday is open mat for gi and no-gi.
hours: Mon, Wed, Fri 4:30pm-7:30pm; Tue, Thu 4:30pm-7pm; Sat-Sun closed

name: Teddy's Jiu Jitsu Academy
desc: Family-run Brazilian jiu-jitsu academy on Holcomb Bridge Road with classes for kids 6 and up and adults, starting every new student with a phone consultation.
about: Teddy's Jiu Jitsu Academy is a family-run Brazilian jiu-jitsu school on Holcomb Bridge Road, serving Alpharetta, Roswell, Johns Creek, Peachtree Corners and Norcross. Co-owner and head instructor Jerad "Teddy" Wheeler started grappling at Georgia State University and trained under Master Roberto Traven, and his background includes competition and law enforcement. He runs the academy with his wife, Kelly Wheeler, a coach who placed third at the 2019 IBJJF Masters World Championship.

Kids classes are split into ages 6 to 8 and 9 and up, and adult classes welcome beginners with no martial arts experience. Training focuses on coached practice and partner drills that explain how and why techniques work.
New students start with a phone consultation, then schedule a trial class. Classes run Tuesday through Thursday evenings and Saturday mornings.
tips: Request a phone consultation to set up a trial.
Kids ages 6 to 8 train Tuesday through Thursday at 5:15pm.
Adult classes are Tuesday and Thursday evenings plus Saturday at noon.
address: 8560 Holcomb Bridge Rd, Ste 102, Alpharetta, GA 30022
hours: Classes Tue 5:15pm-8:30pm; Wed 5:15pm-7pm; Thu 5:15pm-8:30pm; Sat 9:30am-1:30pm; Sun, Mon, Fri closed

name: Iron Horse BJJ
desc: Brazilian jiu-jitsu gym on Alpharetta Highway with gi, no-gi, wrestling and kickboxing classes for kids 4 and up and adults, led by a 3rd-degree black belt.
about: Iron Horse BJJ is a Brazilian jiu-jitsu gym on Alpharetta Highway led by head instructor Anthony Budion, a 3rd-degree jiu-jitsu black belt and MMA practitioner. He trained in New York under former UFC champion Matt Serra and coach Ray Longo, and he is a U.S. Air Force veteran who also served with the NYPD and FDNY.

The schedule includes adult gi and no-gi classes at all levels, fundamentals classes, wrestling and takedowns, and kickboxing and fitness sessions. Kids can start at age 4 in a short gi class, and children 8 and up can join fundamentals sessions alongside adults.

Classes run Monday through Saturday, with midday options for adults and evening classes for families. Memberships include unlimited and twice-weekly plans with military and family discounts, and a free trial is available.
tips: Kids classes start at age 4 with 5pm sessions.
Ask about military and family member discounts.
Midday adult classes suit lunch-hour training.
address: 1497 Alpharetta Hwy, Ste D, Alpharetta, GA 30009
hours: Classes Mon 11am-12pm & 5pm-8pm; Tue 12pm-12:45pm & 5pm-8pm; Wed 5pm-8pm; Thu 12pm-12:45pm & 5pm-8pm; Fri 11am-1pm; Sat 11am-12pm; Sun closed

name: Core Dance & Acrobatics Studios
desc: Performing arts studio on Atlanta Highway offering ballet, tap, jazz, acro, contemporary, hip-hop, musical theater and aerial classes from age 3 through adult.
about: Core Dance & Acrobatics Studios is a performing arts studio on Atlanta Highway in north Alpharetta, near the Milton line. It teaches ballet, tap, jazz, acrobatics, contemporary, hip-hop and musical theater from beginner to advanced levels, with class tracks for ages 3 to 5, 6 to 8, 9 to 11 and 12 and up, plus adult classes.

The facility has three studios with sprung maple floors, one with a Marley surface, and a separate aerial arts room with silks and lyras. Parents can watch class on lobby screens, and dancers have a lounge and homework area between classes. Jayme Leach directs the ballet program, and the studio also runs the Elements Performance Company.
The season includes a holiday show in December, a Nutcracker production and an end-of-season recital in May. The studio also hosts birthday parties.
tips: Parents can watch class on lobby screens.
Ask about aerial silks and lyra classes.
Plan for a December holiday show and May recital.
hours: Mon 4pm-9:30pm; Tue-Thu 4:30pm-9:30pm; Sat 9:30am-12:30pm; Fri and Sun closed

name: Metropolitan Ballet Theatre
desc: Ballet school and company on North Main Street known for its full-length Nutcracker, with year-round auditions, open classes for ages 13 and up, and adult ballet.
about: Metropolitan Ballet Theatre is a ballet school and performing company based on North Main Street in Alpharetta. It is best known locally for its full-length Nutcracker, set to Tchaikovsky's original score, which marks 20 years as a holiday tradition this season and is staged at Blessed Trinity High School in Roswell.

Students who want to train with MBT can audition year-round, either by attending an open class or by special appointment. Open classes offer barre and center work for dancers 13 and up who want extra training time, held weekday afternoons with no audition required. The school also offers adult ballet and dance-based fitness classes for mature students, including beginners and former dancers.
Nutcracker performances include evening shows, matinees and a Sugarplum Storytime matinee that pairs the ballet with a storytime for young children.
tips: Auditions are year-round through open classes.
Open classes for ages 13 and up need no audition.
Look for Sugarplum Storytime matinees for young kids.
address: 875 N Main St, Ste 354, Alpharetta, GA 30009
hours: Mon 4pm-8pm; Tue 1pm-7:30pm; Wed-Fri 1pm-8pm; Sat 10:30am-3pm; Sun closed

name: The Hamilton Alpharetta, Curio Collection by Hilton
desc: Boutique Curio Collection by Hilton hotel in downtown Alpharetta with railroad-inspired design, Carrie's patio bar, Fulton's Public House breakfast and event space.
about: The Hamilton is a boutique hotel in Alpharetta's downtown historic district and part of Hilton's Curio Collection. Its design draws on the history of the Western & Atlantic Railway, mixing classical architecture with industrial touches. Travel listings show 119 rooms across four floors.

Rooms include Waldorf Astoria beds, blackout curtains, 50-inch HDTVs, mini-fridges, Frette robes and complimentary Wi-Fi. Standard kings run 290 to 364 square feet, and studio suites have floor-to-ceiling windows. Carrie's, the patio bar, serves lunch, brunch, social hour and dinner, while Fulton's Public House handles daily breakfast. The hotel also has about 3,500 square feet of meeting space and a private lounge.

Check-in starts at 4 PM and check-out is at 11 AM. Valet drop-off is on Old Canton St and pick-up is on Milton Ave, with a public garage across the street at 97 Milton Ave. Pets are not allowed, though service animals are welcome.
tips: Valet drops off on Old Canton St and picks up on Milton Ave
A public parking garage sits across the street at 97 Milton Ave
Check-in starts at 4 PM; check-out is 11 AM

name: Atlanta Marriott Alpharetta
desc: Full-service Marriott on Windward Parkway with 318 rooms, the 19 North restaurant, indoor and seasonal outdoor pools, free self parking and 14 meeting rooms.
about: Atlanta Marriott Alpharetta is a full-service hotel in the Windward Parkway business corridor. Travel listings show 318 rooms in a single eight-floor building, which makes it one of the larger hotels in the city and a common pick for corporate travelers and group events.

On-site dining includes the 19 North restaurant, a bar and a lobby coffee kiosk. Guests have an indoor pool, a seasonal outdoor pool open roughly June through September, a hot tub and a 24-hour fitness center. For meetings there are 14 rooms with about 7,680 square feet of conference space, plus a 24-hour business center. Self parking is free.

Check-in begins at 4 PM and check-out is at noon, with express and contactless options. Pets are not allowed, though service animals are welcome. The hotel sits close to GA 400, so Avalon, Halcyon and downtown Alpharetta are a short drive.
tips: Self parking is free
The outdoor pool is seasonal; the indoor pool is open year round
Pets are not allowed, but service animals are welcome

name: Embassy Suites by Hilton Atlanta Alpharetta
desc: All-suite Embassy Suites on North Point Parkway with free breakfast, a nightly manager's reception, an indoor pool, free parking and pet-friendly rooms.
about: Embassy Suites by Hilton Atlanta Alpharetta is an all-suite hotel on North Point Parkway, close to North Point Mall and GA 400. Suites have separate living areas and kitchen appliances, which suits families and longer business stays.

A free breakfast buffet and a free evening manager's reception are included. The hotel has an indoor pool open 6 AM to 10 PM, a fitness center, a bar and free self parking. For events there is a ballroom and several smaller meeting rooms, with capacity listed for groups of up to 240 guests.

Check-in runs from 4 PM to midnight and check-out is at 11 AM; late check-out may be available for a fee. Cats and dogs up to 50 pounds are allowed, two per room, for a per-stay fee. Service animals are exempt.
tips: Breakfast and the evening reception are included
Dogs and cats up to 50 lbs are allowed for a fee
Self parking is free

name: Aloft Alpharetta
desc: Pet-friendly Aloft by Marriott on North Point Parkway with 120 rooms, a bar, a seasonal outdoor pool, free self parking and an EV charging station.
about: Aloft Alpharetta is a Marriott-branded hotel on North Point Parkway in the 30022 ZIP code, near North Point Mall and the GA 400 interchanges. Travel listings show 120 rooms, and the brand's style leans casual and modern.

The hotel has a bar, a seasonal outdoor pool with loungers that closes in the cooler months, free self parking and an electric vehicle charging station. The city's visitor bureau lists breakfast, a fitness center, meeting space and a restaurant among its amenities.

Check-in starts at 3 PM and check-out is at noon. Cats and dogs are allowed with a nightly fee and deposit, and service animals are exempt. It is a practical base for shows at Ameris Bank Amphitheatre, shopping at Avalon or business in the North Point area.
tips: Check-in starts at 3 PM, earlier than many nearby hotels
There is an EV charging station on site
The outdoor pool is seasonal and closes in autumn

name: Courtyard Atlanta Alpharetta/Avalon Area
desc: Courtyard by Marriott near Avalon with 115 rooms on six floors, The Bistro for breakfast and dinner, an indoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center.
about: Courtyard Atlanta Alpharetta/Avalon Area is a Marriott hotel on Amber Park Drive, a short drive from Avalon's shops and restaurants and from downtown Alpharetta. Travel listings show 115 rooms across six floors.

The Bistro on site serves breakfast and dinner. Other amenities include an indoor pool, a 24-hour fitness center and meeting space, and the city's visitor bureau also lists a shuttle among its services. Self parking is available for a daily fee with in and out privileges, and accessible parking is provided.

Check-in starts at 3 PM and check-out is at noon. Guests must be at least 21 to check in. Up to two pets of 50 pounds or less are allowed for a nightly fee plus a one-time cleaning fee, and service animals are exempt. The hotel works well for visitors heading to Avalon, Wills Park or events across the Old Milton Parkway corridor.
tips: Minimum check-in age is 21
Self parking carries a daily fee
Up to two pets under 50 lbs are allowed for a fee

name: The Golf Club of Georgia
desc: Private 36-hole golf club in Alpharetta, founded in 1991, that hosts weddings, banquets and golf outings in its Lodge ballroom and the wine-cellar style Cellar 91.
about: The Golf Club of Georgia is a private club established in 1991, known for its Lakeside and Creekside courses designed by Arthur Hills. Beyond golf, the club rents its spaces for weddings, showers, banquets, corporate meetings and golf outings.

The main event space is the Lodge, a ballroom with wood framing and a large rustic chandelier, added during a $40 million clubhouse renovation completed in 2016. Couples can hold ceremonies on the course grounds and receptions in the Lodge, while Cellar 91 offers a smaller setting styled after a Napa Valley wine cellar. Meeting rooms include the Boardroom, the Dogwood Room and the Meeting Room. An on-site events team handles planning from the first walkthrough to the send-off, and the culinary team builds custom menus.
Events are booked through the club's events team by phone or email, and tours are scheduled in advance.
tips: Call the events team at (770) 772-8160 to book a tour
Cellar 91 suits smaller dinners and rehearsal events
Golf outings can be paired with a banquet in the Lodge

name: Royal Banquet
desc: Banquet hall on Windward Parkway for weddings, corporate events and parties, with room for up to 300 guests, a bridal suite, catering options and in-house planning.
about: Royal Banquet is an event hall on Windward Parkway that hosts weddings, corporate functions, birthdays, anniversaries, reunions, seminars and office parties. Its halls can accommodate up to 300 guests with flexible seating layouts.

The venue offers customizable decor and themes, a dance floor, a stage area, a large digital display and a built-in sound system with a DJ booth. Catering covers a range of menus, from traditional dishes to international cuisine, and the team can adjust menus for dietary needs. Wedding clients have use of a private bridal suite, and event coordinators help with details such as floral arrangements and seating plans.
The hall is close to several Windward Parkway hotels, which helps with out-of-town guests. Bookings and tours are arranged by phone or through the inquiry form on the venue's website.
tips: Ask about the private bridal suite for wedding days
The hall seats up to 300 guests
Several Windward Parkway hotels are nearby for guest stays

name: Noor Studio and Gallery
desc: Downtown Alpharetta art gallery and studio that hosts private parties, sip and paint nights, brunch and paint, corporate team events and exhibitions.
about: Noor Studio and Gallery is an art gallery and studio near downtown Alpharetta that doubles as a private event space. Founder Sanaz Noori describes it as a meeting place for art lovers, and the name comes from her last name, which translates from Farsi as light.

Private event packages include sip and paint parties, date nights, birthday painting parties for all ages, brunch and paint, lunch or dinner and paint, tea parties, corporate team building, school events and private exhibitions. Guests gather among the gallery's rotating collection of paintings and mixed-media work. The studio also runs adult and kids' art classes, workshops and summer camps, and it can bring painting and pottery activities to an off-site location.
A gift shop sells prints, jewelry, art supplies and collectible currencies. Full event package details are available on the website, and bookings can be made online or by phone.
tips: Best suited to smaller groups and private parties
Ask about off-site painting and pottery activities
Review the event package PDF on the website before booking

name: Paws N Pearls
desc: All-breed dog grooming salon in the Village at Crooked Creek on Atlanta Hwy, run by a groomer with decades of experience grooming pet and show dogs.
about: Paws N Pearls is an all-breed dog grooming salon in the Village at Crooked Creek shopping center on Atlanta Highway (State Route 9). Owner Missy Crane has groomed both pet and show dogs for decades, including 13 years at Veterinary Medical Center in Alpharetta.

Full grooming includes a bath with a shampoo matched to the coat, a haircut in the style you choose, paw pad trimming, a sanitary trim, nail trim and Dremel, ear cleaning and anal gland expression. A shorter mini groom is also available. Hypoallergenic and flea and tick shampoos can be requested. The salon's show background shows in breed-specific work such as hand stripping terriers and scissoring poodles, Bichons and Shih Tzus.
Grooming is by appointment, so call ahead to book. From GA 400, take the McFarland Road exit and head to Atlanta Highway; the salon is about 0.4 miles down on the right.
tips: Call ahead; grooming is by appointment
Ask for hypoallergenic or flea and tick shampoo if needed
Closed Sunday and Monday

name: The Barker Lounge Alpharetta
desc: Cage-free dog daycare, overnight boarding, grooming and training on Atlanta Hwy, with all-day group play and over 7,000 square feet of outdoor play space.
about: The Barker Lounge Alpharetta offers doggy daycare, overnight boarding, grooming and training. Boarding guests join all-day group play, so dogs are only out of the play areas to eat and sleep. The facility serves Alpharetta, Cumming, Milton and Johns Creek.

The building has more than 7,000 square feet of indoor space with large cage-less play areas, orthopedic floor mats and private boarding suites in standard and family sizes, plus more than 7,000 square feet of gated outdoor play space. It is climate controlled with an air filtration system, and indoor and outdoor cameras are monitored around the clock. A full-service groom shop is on site.

New dogs must complete a free Meet and Greet before booking daycare or boarding, and only a few new dogs are accepted each day, so plan ahead. The first day of daycare is free. Hours are 7am to 7pm daily, with dogs cared for but the lobby closed on major holidays.
tips: Schedule the free Meet and Greet well before you travel
The first day of daycare is free
Check the posted holiday schedule before booking
hours: Daily 7am-7pm (closed to the public on major holidays)

name: Dogtopia of Alpharetta at Halcyon
desc: Dog daycare, overnight boarding and spa services at Halcyon, with supervised open-play rooms grouped by size and temperament plus webcams for owners.
about: Dogtopia of Alpharetta at Halcyon provides dog daycare, overnight and long-term boarding, and spa services. It is part of the Dogtopia franchise and sits in the Halcyon development off McGinnis Ferry Road.

Daycare is off-leash open play in supervised playrooms. Dogs are grouped by size, temperament and play style, and every dog must be fully vaccinated and pass a Dogtopia evaluation first. Playrooms are supervised by Canine Coaches whose training is certified by two national canine behavior associations. Half-day and full-day daycare are available, and spa services can be added to daycare or boarding stays. Owners can check in through webcams on a computer or phone.

New clients can book a first visit online or by phone. The location runs on weekday hours from 7am to 7pm and shorter Saturday hours, and it is closed Sunday, which matters when planning boarding drop-off and pickup.
tips: Dogs must pass an evaluation and be fully vaccinated
Use the webcams to check on your dog during the day
Plan boarding pickups around the Sunday closure

name: Pet Lodge Pet Resort
desc: Pet resort on 13 acres off Bethany Bend offering dog, cat and exotic boarding, daycare, grooming and obedience training, serving the area since 1978.
about: Pet Lodge Pet Resort has served Atlanta's pet community since 1978 from a 13-acre property on Bethany Bend in north Alpharetta. It offers dog, cat and exotic pet boarding, dog daycare, grooming and obedience training.

The grounds include more than 20,000 square feet of outdoor turf with obstacles, toys and pools, plus a swimming pool, splash park, puppy play station, nature trails and agility equipment. Boarding offers several accommodation types and add-on activities. Training is led by a trainer with more than two decades of experience and includes group classes and private lessons. Owners can watch webcams through the customer portal, and the resort also offers a pet taxi and retail pet supplies.
The resort is open seven days a week, including Sunday afternoons and evenings, which makes weekend pickups easier. Call or text to book, or reserve online through the booking portal.
tips: Open on Sundays from 10am, unlike many boarding facilities
Ask about the pet taxi service
Watch webcams through the customer portal

name: Inspired Living at Alpharetta
desc: Assisted living and memory care community on Morris Road with respite stays, chef-prepared Any Time Dining, a swimming pool and 24-hour staff on site.
about: Inspired Living at Alpharetta is a senior community on Morris Road offering assisted living and memory care, along with short-term respite stays. It is a few minutes from Avalon, North Point Mall and Wills Park.

Assisted living residents get help with daily living, medication support from nurses and caregivers, housekeeping, laundry, transportation, regularly visiting physicians and prepared meals. Memory care is purpose-built for residents living with Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia. Respite stays can run from a few days to several weeks, for example after a hospital stay or to give a family caregiver a break.

The Any Time Dining program serves chef-prepared meals whenever residents choose. Amenities include fitness areas, swimming pools, walking paths, a dog park, a computer room and activity spaces. Suites are private or shared, utilities and basic cable are included, and small pets of 30 pounds or less are welcome. Emergency pull cords and pendants are backed by 24-hour on-site staff.
tips: Schedule a tour through the website or by phone
Small pets up to 30 lbs are allowed
Ask about short-term respite stays

name: Arbor Terrace Crabapple
desc: Arbor Company senior community on Crabapple Road offering assisted living, the Bridges program for early cognitive decline and Evergreen memory care.
about: Arbor Terrace Crabapple is a senior living community on Crabapple Road operated by The Arbor Company. It offers three options: assisted living, the Bridges program for seniors in the early stages of cognitive decline, and memory care in its Evergreen neighborhood for residents living with Alzheimer's disease or other forms of dementia, with care around the clock.

Services and amenities include restaurant-style dining, concierge services, fitness and wellness programs, housekeeping, laundry, accessible transportation and an on-site beauty salon and spa. A monthly social calendar covers classes, hobbies, outings and volunteer activities, and there is a patio with rocking chairs and walking areas. The community offers pet-friendly accommodations.
Starting rates for each apartment type are posted on the website, along with a cost calculator that compares senior living with aging in place. Tours can be scheduled online or by phone.
tips: Use the cost calculator on the website before touring
Ask about the Bridges program for early memory changes
Pets are welcome in pet-friendly apartments
hours: Memory care staffed 24/7; tours by appointment

name: Village Park Alpharetta
desc: Resort-style senior community on Morris Road with independent living, assisted living and memory care in apartments, city homes, bungalows and cottages.
about: Village Park Alpharetta is a senior living community on Morris Road offering independent living, assisted living and memory care. It is developed by Galerie Living and sits a few minutes from Avalon and downtown Alpharetta.

Residences range from apartments to city homes, bungalows and cottages, many with full kitchens, washers and dryers and 10-foot ceilings. Under its Adaptive Care Model, the main campus is licensed as assisted living, so an independent home can be converted to assisted living without moving. Assisted living includes 24/7 care staff and nurses, three meals daily, housekeeping and scheduled transportation. The memory care neighborhood serves residents with Alzheimer's disease and other dementias and includes secured entry, private suites and safe outdoor courtyards.

On-site physical, occupational and speech therapies are available, along with a fitness and wellness program, planned outings and chef-led dining. The community is pet friendly. Call for pricing and availability or schedule a tour online.
tips: Call for current pricing and availability
Independent homes can convert to assisted living in place
Ask about the Daily Enrichment Program for early memory loss
hours: Care staff on site 24/7; tours by appointment

name: The Florist at Windward
desc: Longtime Windward Parkway flower shop with same-day local delivery, wedding and event flowers, sympathy designs, gifts and a build-your-own Bloom Bar.
about: The Florist at Windward is a flower and gift shop in Windward Plaza, the shopping center behind Discount Tire, next to Beto's Tacos and Giant Sports Cards. Owner Liz Johnson bought the longtime shop in March 2025 and has expanded it into gifts and gatherings.

The shop designs arrangements for birthdays, anniversaries, get well wishes and holidays, along with sympathy and funeral flowers, wedding and event work, corporate flowers and flower subscriptions. Gift options include baskets, candles, chocolates, balloons, plants and concierge gift wrapping. The Bloom Bar lets customers build their own bouquet in store, book private parties or bring a mobile bar to an event.

Same-day delivery is available across North Atlanta for orders placed by 2 PM on weekdays or noon on Saturday. Note that Google Maps sometimes points to The Original Pancake House, which shares the same shopping center; look for the stone storefront in Suite 107E.
tips: Order by 2 PM weekdays or noon Saturday for same-day delivery
Look for Suite 107E behind Discount Tire
Check the website for holiday closures before visiting

name: Stems on the Move Alpharetta
desc: Neighborhood florist on Crabapple Road delivering arrangements for birthdays, anniversaries, sympathy, weddings and holidays across Alpharetta and North Atlanta.
about: Stems on the Move Alpharetta is a neighborhood florist on Crabapple Road that serves Alpharetta and nearby communities. Its website operates at the flowersfromus.net address, and the shop is listed as a Premier Florist on the BloomNation marketplace.

The shop designs arrangements for birthdays, anniversaries, holidays and everyday occasions, plus sympathy and funeral flowers. It also offers wedding and event consultations, flower subscriptions and a loyalty rewards program. Orders can be placed online for delivery to homes, hospitals, businesses and event venues.

Same-day delivery may be available depending on the delivery address, product availability and the time the order is placed. The delivery area reaches well beyond Alpharetta, including Milton, Roswell, Johns Creek, Cumming, Sandy Springs, Dunwoody, Marietta and Woodstock. The storefront keeps weekday hours until 4 PM and closes at noon on Saturday, so plan in-person pickups early.
tips: Saturday hours end at noon
Order early in the day for the best chance at same-day delivery
Ask about a consultation for wedding or event flowers

name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup of Alpharetta
desc: Roto-Rooter's Alpharetta branch handles plumbing repair, drain cleaning, sewer line work and water cleanup around the clock from an office on Cambridge Square.
about: Roto-Rooter of Alpharetta works out of a local office on Cambridge Square, a short drive from Old Milton Parkway and Highway 9. The branch is part of the national Roto-Rooter plumbing company, a brand that dates to 1935, and it is staffed by licensed and insured plumbers.

Services cover general plumbing repairs, water heaters, drain cleaning, sewer line repair, video camera sewer inspections, hydro jetting and water damage cleanup. The local page points out issues common in Alpharetta homes, including aging galvanized, cast iron or clay pipes, tree root intrusion into lines and drainage problems around foundations.

The branch answers calls 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and says it does not add extra charges for nights, weekends or holidays on plumbing and drain service. That makes it a practical first call for a backed-up main line or a burst pipe outside normal business hours.
tips: Call any time; the Alpharetta branch takes plumbing and drain calls 24/7.
Ask about a video camera inspection if a main line backs up more than once.
Water damage cleanup is offered too, so one call can cover the leak and the mess.
address: 1060 Cambridge Square, Ste D, Alpharetta, GA 30009

name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Atlanta
desc: Locally owned Mr. Rooter franchise based in Roswell that serves Alpharetta with plumbing repair, drain cleaning, sewer line work and emergency service.
about: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Atlanta is a locally owned and independently operated franchise of the Mr. Rooter brand, part of the Neighborly family of home service companies. Its office sits on Bush Street in Roswell, and Alpharetta is one of the communities on its service list.

The team's licensed plumbers handle residential and commercial plumbing repair, clogged and basement drains, drain cleaning, HydroScrub drain jetting, sewer camera inspections, sewer line repair and emergency plumbing. The company also lists septic drain field installation and service, which can matter for homes on septic in the northern parts of the area.
Scheduling is available around the clock, and the company says its workmanship and parts are guaranteed. Expect a technician to come to your home rather than a storefront visit.
tips: Scheduling is available 24/7, so emergencies can be booked after hours.
Ask about HydroScrub jetting for recurring sewer or drain clogs.
Homes on septic can ask about drain field service as well.

name: Moncrief Heating & Air Conditioning
desc: Long-running Atlanta heating, air and plumbing company, now part of Ace Hardware, with an Alpharetta office on Windward Ridge Parkway and around-the-clock phone and text service.
about: Moncrief Heating & Air Conditioning has served Atlanta and North Georgia since 1898 and now operates as an Ace Hardware company. Alongside its Atlanta headquarters it keeps an Alpharetta office on Windward Ridge Parkway, close to GA-400 and the Windward business district.

The company installs, repairs and maintains heating and cooling systems, including air conditioners, furnaces, heat pumps, boilers and ductless mini splits, plus humidifiers and air purifiers for indoor air quality. It also runs a plumbing side covering water heaters, tankless units, drain cleaning, leak detection, toilets, faucets and sewer line replacement.

Moncrief offers maintenance plans, financing and free estimates on system replacements, and it notes that diagnostic charges apply to repair visits. Phones and texts are answered 24/7, and online scheduling is available for routine service.
tips: Call or text any time; the company lists 24/7 availability.
Ask about a maintenance plan if you want seasonal tune-ups scheduled for you.
The same company can handle plumbing, so mention water heater issues on an HVAC visit.
address: 1060 Windward Ridge Pkwy, Ste 100, Alpharetta, GA 30005

name: Lee Company
desc: Heating, cooling, plumbing and electrical company serving the Southeast since 1944, with a local team on Alpharetta Highway at the Roswell and Alpharetta line.
about: Lee Company has served homes and businesses in the Southeast since 1944. Its local office is on Alpharetta Highway just inside Roswell, near the Alpharetta city line, and the company describes it as its local Alpharetta team. It is a BBB Accredited Business.

For homeowners, the HVAC team handles air conditioning and heating repair, system replacement and routine maintenance. The company suggests booking upkeep twice a year, a cooling check before summer and a furnace check in the fall, and it gives side by side advice on repairing an older system versus upgrading to a more efficient one.

The same office also offers plumbing, electrical and handyman services, and a separate division serves commercial facilities. Emergency HVAC service is available 24 hours a day, which helps when an air conditioner fails on a summer weekend.
tips: Emergency HVAC service is available 24/7.
Book maintenance twice a year: cooling in spring, heating in fall.
The same office also handles plumbing and electrical work.

name: ClimateSmith
desc: Family owned heating and air conditioning company based in south Forsyth County that services all brands for homes and businesses in Alpharetta, Milton and Johns Creek.
about: ClimateSmith is a family owned and operated heating and air conditioning contractor based on Performance Drive in Cumming. It markets itself as an Alpharetta HVAC company and lists Alpharetta, Milton, Crabapple, Roswell, Johns Creek and Cumming among the areas it serves across Fulton, Forsyth and Gwinnett counties.

Residential work includes AC repair, furnace repair and replacement, heat pump installation and repair, ductless mini splits, new system installation and routine maintenance under a maintenance plan. The company services all brands. On the commercial side it offers HVAC service, repair and maintenance for offices and other businesses.

The office is open on weekdays during business hours and closed on weekends. The company's blog covers common local problems such as a second floor that stays warmer than the first, which is useful reading before a service call.
tips: Call on weekdays; the office is closed Saturday and Sunday.
Ask about the maintenance plan for regular tune-ups.
They service all brands, so you do not need the original installer.

name: Mr. Electric of Roswell - Alpharetta
desc: Locally owned Mr. Electric franchise on Hembree Road handling home and business electrical repairs, lighting, panel upgrades, generators and EV charger installs.
about: Mr. Electric of Roswell - Alpharetta is a locally owned and operated franchise of Mr. Electric, part of the Neighborly group of home service brands. The office is on Hembree Road in Alpharetta, and the service area covers Alpharetta, Roswell, Milton, Johns Creek, Sandy Springs, Mountain Park, Berkeley Lake and Norcross.

The electricians take on repairs and installations for homes and businesses. Listed services include electrical panel upgrades, outlet installation, ceiling fans, LED and energy efficient lighting, outdoor, deck and cabinet lighting, lighting controls, home generators, knob and tube wiring upgrades, carbon monoxide and smoke detectors, and EV charger installation and repair.

The company says every team member goes through background screening and ongoing training. Calls are taken for scheduling 24 hours a day, so you can book an emergency visit or a planned project at any time.
tips: Call any time to schedule; the line is staffed 24/7.
Ask about an EV charger install if you are adding an electric vehicle.
Older homes can ask about knob and tube wiring upgrades.

name: TE Certified Electrical, Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
desc: Metro Atlanta electrical, plumbing and HVAC company serving the area since 2003, with a Roswell office that covers Alpharetta and offers same day service.
about: TE Certified Electrical, Plumbing, Heating & Cooling has served the Atlanta area since 2003. It runs offices in Roswell, Lawrenceville, Kennesaw and Jonesboro, and the Roswell office on Old Dogwood Road is the one that covers Alpharetta.

The company started with electrical work and still leads with it: repairs to lights, outlets, breakers and GFCI devices, installations, and whole house generators. It also employs licensed plumbers and heating and air technicians, and it lists its state electrical, low voltage, HVAC and master plumber license numbers on its contact page.

TE Certified offers same day service with three hour arrival windows and a courtesy call 30 minutes before the technician arrives. Trucks are stocked so many jobs can be finished on the first visit. The office accepts Zelle, check and major credit cards.
tips: Same day appointments come with a three hour arrival window.
Saturday hours make weekend electrical work easier to book.
One call can also cover plumbing or HVAC problems.

name: Mr. Handyman of Roswell, Alpharetta and Cumming
desc: Locally owned Mr. Handyman franchise in Roswell that sends insured technicians to Alpharetta homes and businesses for repairs, maintenance and small projects.
about: Mr. Handyman of Roswell, Alpharetta and Cumming is a locally owned and operated franchise of Mr. Handyman, a Neighborly brand. The office is on Old Roswell Place in Roswell, and the service area includes Alpharetta, Milton, Johns Creek, Roswell and Cumming.

The team handles the repair and maintenance jobs that pile up around a house or business, such as rotting deck boards, drafty windows, broken tile, flooring, drywall, doors, carbon monoxide and smoke detector installs, and seasonal maintenance checklists. It works for homeowners as well as commercial properties.

The company says its technicians average about 10 years of experience in the trades, the team is fully insured, and its workmanship is guaranteed. The office keeps standard weekday hours, so plan to call during the work week to set up an estimate or a visit.
tips: Call on weekdays between 8am and 5pm to book.
Group several small repairs into one visit to save trips.
Commercial properties can use the service too.
address: 770 Old Roswell Pl, Ste G-300, Roswell, GA 30076

name: Ace Handyman Services NW Metro Atlanta
desc: Ace Hardware's handyman franchise in Roswell, serving Alpharetta and Milton with background checked craftsmen for repairs, painting, carpentry and small remodels.
about: Ace Handyman Services NW Metro Atlanta is a locally owned and independently operated franchise of Ace Handyman Services, part of the Ace Hardware family. Its office is on West Crossville Road in Roswell, and it serves Alpharetta, Milton, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Dunwoody, East Cobb and Woodstock.

The craftsmen cover a wide list of home projects: drywall repair, carpentry, painting and staining, doors and windows, flooring, gutters, fencing, siding, tile, power washing, furniture assembly, aging in place updates, and kitchen and bathroom refreshes and remodels. A commercial service handles offices, retail stores, restaurants, schools and medical offices.

The company says every craftsman is background checked and that work carries a one year labor warranty. Weekday hours are standard, and weekend visits can be arranged by appointment. Projects can often start within a day or two of approval.
tips: Weekend work is available by appointment.
Work comes with a one year labor warranty.
Ask about aging in place updates such as grab bars.
address: 45 W Crossville Rd, Ste 511-B, Roswell, GA 30075

name: Crash Champions Collision Repair Alpharetta
desc: I-CAR Gold Class collision shop on Hembree Road offering collision repair, paintless dent repair, ADAS calibration and on-site rental cars, backed by a lifetime guarantee.
about: Crash Champions Alpharetta is a collision repair center on Hembree Road in north Fulton County, a few minutes from GA-400 and the Windward Parkway corridor. It is one of more than 650 Crash Champions locations nationwide.

The shop handles everyday collision repair and paintless dent repair, and it calibrates Advanced Driver Assistance Systems such as cameras, sensors and radar after a repair. It holds I-CAR Gold Class status. A service advisor reviews the damage, runs a pre scan and writes the preliminary estimate. Typical turnaround runs three to ten business days, depending on structural work and parts.

The shop works directly with most major insurers and offers on-site rental car pickup. Repairs carry a written lifetime guarantee that is honored at any Crash Champions location. Free estimates are available at the counter on weekdays.
tips: Bring your claim number to speed up the estimate.
Rental cars can be picked up on site at drop off.
The shop is closed Saturdays, so plan drop off on a weekday.

name: Gerber Collision & Glass - Alpharetta
desc: Gerber's Atlanta Highway body shop repairs all makes and models, from dents and bumpers to frame straightening, with free estimates and a national lifetime guarantee.
about: Gerber Collision & Glass Alpharetta is a full service auto body shop on Atlanta Highway (GA-9) north of downtown Alpharetta. It is part of Gerber Collision & Glass, a large North American collision repair network.

The shop repairs all makes and models. Services include collision and auto body repair, dent and scratch repair, paintless dent repair, bumper repair, frame straightening and auto paint work. The Gerber network also offers auto glass replacement and repair. The Alpharetta shop holds I-CAR Gold Class status.

Written repair estimates are free, the shop bills insurance directly, and deductible financing is available. Repairs are backed by Gerber's National Lifetime Guarantee for as long as you own the vehicle. You can schedule a collision appointment or request an online estimate through the website before you come in.
tips: Request an online collision estimate before your visit.
Ask about deductible financing if the bill is due up front.
Hours are weekdays only, 8am to 5pm.

name: Classic Collision Alpharetta
desc: South Main Street collision center from Classic Collision, an Atlanta-born chain founded in 1983, offering free estimates, tow and rental help, glass work and a lifetime warranty.
about: Classic Collision Alpharetta sits on South Main Street, just south of downtown Alpharetta. Classic Collision was founded in Atlanta in 1983 and has grown to more than 300 repair centers across the country.

The Alpharetta shop focuses on collision repair and lists free estimates, tow assistance, rental assistance, glass replacement and a lifetime warranty among its services. The wider company also handles ADAS calibrations and electronic repairs after a crash. You can start with a photo estimate on the website or schedule an appointment online.

Weekday hours run later than many body shops, until 6pm, and Saturday visits are available by appointment, which helps if you cannot drop a car off during the work week. The shop is closed on Sundays.
tips: Send photos online for a quick estimate.
Saturday appointments are possible if weekdays don't work.
Ask the shop to arrange tow and rental help after a crash.
hours: Mon-Fri 8am-6pm; Sat by appointment; Sun closed

name: Christian Brothers Automotive Alpharetta Milton
desc: Owner-run Christian Brothers shop on Atlanta Highway near Crooked Creek, offering full auto repair and maintenance with a free shuttle and after hours key drop.
about: Christian Brothers Automotive Alpharetta Milton is owned and operated by Mike and Cathy Cotter, who first came to the brand as customers. The shop is a locally owned franchise of Christian Brothers Automotive.

It is at 6290 Atlanta Highway, about half a mile from The Crooked Creek Golf Club near the Village at Crooked Creek. From GA-400, take Exit 12B to McFarland Parkway, turn left on Atlanta Highway, and the shop is about a quarter mile on the right. It serves Alpharetta and Milton, including the Windward and Avalon areas.

The shop handles comprehensive auto repair and maintenance with certified technicians and courtesy inspections. Amenities include a free shuttle, after hours key drop off, free Wi-Fi and refreshments, a waiting lounge, special financing and mobile service. The shop is open weekdays and closed on weekends.
tips: Use the after hours key drop if you can't make it by 6pm.
Ask for the free shuttle to get to work while your car is in.
From GA-400 use Exit 12B to McFarland Parkway.

name: Firestone Complete Auto Care
desc: North Main Street tire and auto service center selling tires and handling oil changes, brakes, alignments, batteries, inspections and hybrid and EV maintenance.
about: This Firestone Complete Auto Care store, number 282013, is on North Main Street just north of downtown Alpharetta. It is part of the national Firestone Complete Auto Care chain of tire and auto service centers.

The store sells and installs tires and handles routine and repair work, including oil changes, brakes, wheel alignment, batteries, air conditioning, engine repair and inspections. A complete vehicle inspection checks steering, suspension and brakes. The store also performs bumper to bumper maintenance and repair on hybrid and electric vehicles using specialized tools and technicians.

You can pre-book a repair or maintenance appointment online to save time at the counter. Weekday hours run from early morning into the evening and the shop is open Saturdays, which helps if you cannot leave your car during the work week. A Firestone credit card with promotional financing is offered.
tips: Book online ahead of time to skip the wait at the counter.
Open until 7pm on weekdays and on Saturdays.
Hybrid and EV owners can get maintenance here too.

name: Valvoline Instant Oil Change - Cotton Creek
desc: Drive-in Valvoline oil change on Old Milton Parkway east of Avalon, where you stay in your car for a roughly 15 minute oil change with no appointment needed.
about: The Cotton Creek Valvoline Instant Oil Change is on Old Milton Parkway about 1.5 miles east of Avalon, near the Brookside Parkway intersection and next to Dunkin'. It serves Alpharetta and nearby neighborhoods toward Johns Creek.

The main service is a stay-in-your-car full service oil change that takes about 15 minutes. Other services include air filters, battery replacement, wiper blades, light bulbs, serpentine belts, tire rotation, radiator, transmission and differential service, fuel system cleaning, air conditioning, state inspections, fleet service and electric vehicle services.

No appointment is needed for any service, so you can simply pull in. Unlike many shops, this location is open seven days a week, including Sunday afternoons. Coupons for new and returning customers are posted on the location page.
tips: No appointment needed; just pull in.
Open seven days, including Sunday 10am to 5pm.
Check the location page for current oil change coupons.

name: Two Men and a Truck of Alpharetta
desc: Alpharetta franchise of the national moving brand, handling local and long-distance household moves, packing and office relocations from its McFarland 400 Drive base.
about: Two Men and a Truck of Alpharetta is the local franchise of the national moving company, operating from an office on McFarland 400 Drive near GA 400 in north Alpharetta. The location says its franchise owner founded the business in 2000, and several crew members have been with the team for years.

Services include local moves, long-distance and interstate moves, professional packing, and home and business relocations. For interstate moves with flexible dates, the brand offers a crate-based option called Value Flex, as well as dedicated expedited service with a firm delivery date.

Movers are full-time employees who go through background checks and drug screening, and trucks come stocked with pads, shrink wrap and dollies. Estimates are handled by sales consultants who walk customers through options before moving day.
tips: Ask about Value Flex if your interstate move date is flexible and your load is small.
Label boxes by room and floor so the crew can unload faster.
Plan to move plants, pets, propane and perishable food yourself; the crews will not carry them.

name: USA Family Moving & Storage
desc: Veteran-owned, family-run mover with a 17,000 square foot Alpharetta warehouse, offering local, long-distance and office moves, packing, storage and junk removal.
about: USA Family Moving & Storage is a family business founded by Kermit Escribano, a former 82nd Airborne soldier and police officer, and his wife Ericka de la Garza. The company lists its Alpharetta location on Curie Drive, where it keeps a 17,000 square foot warehouse, along with a second storage facility in Atlanta.

Services cover local, long-distance, interstate and international moves, office and commercial relocations, piano moving, full or partial packing, labor-only loading help, climate-controlled storage and household junk removal. The company says it completes about 2,000 moves a year across North Fulton and Forsyth County.

Crews are background checked, drug tested and trained in house, and each job is assigned a move coordinator. The company holds US DOT 3447326 and Georgia MCA 8990, and its phone line is listed as open around the clock.
tips: Ask for a virtual or onsite estimate so crew size and truck count are set before moving day.
Labor-only help is available if you already rented a truck or container.
Junk removal covers household items only, not construction debris, paint or chemicals.

name: Best Deal Movers
desc: Family-owned, veteran-owned moving company based on Shiloh Road East in Alpharetta, offering local and long-distance moves, packing, office moves, supplies and junk removal.
about: Best Deal Movers is a family-owned and veteran-owned moving company with its office on Shiloh Road East, in the Alpharetta area near McGinnis Ferry Road. It serves Alpharetta, Milton, Roswell, Johns Creek, Cumming and other North Metro Atlanta communities, plus longer moves across the Southeast.

Services include local moving, long-distance moving, packing and unpacking, office and commercial moves, moving boxes and supplies, and junk removal for appliances, furniture and boxes. The company offers video-based quotes and says its crews are trained, background checked, licensed and insured.

The office keeps weekday hours plus a short Saturday morning window, which is a good time to ask about supplies or schedule an estimate. Quote requests can also be submitted online with move date and home size.
tips: Request a video-based quote to skip an in-home walkthrough.
Buy boxes and packing supplies from the company ahead of your move date.
Call on a weekday or Saturday morning; the office is closed Sundays.
address: 6865 Shiloh Rd. East, Ste. 200, Alpharetta, GA 30005

name: Jason Taylor Moving & Storage
desc: North Metro Atlanta mover with an Alpharetta office and Cumming base, offering residential, commercial and long-distance moves, packing and crating, vault storage and junk hauling.
about: Jason Taylor Moving & Storage is a full-service moving and storage company with locations in Alpharetta, on Commerce Boulevard, and in Cumming. It describes itself as a family-rooted business that grew from a local operation into one of North Metro Atlanta's established movers.

Services include residential and local moves, commercial and office relocations, long-distance moves, full packing and custom crating, climate-controlled vault storage, document storage, organizing and junk hauling. Commercial moves can be scheduled during off-peak hours and weekends to limit downtime for businesses.

The company serves Alpharetta, Milton, Roswell, Johns Creek, Cumming and communities further north. The Alpharetta office keeps weekday hours, and it says crews are familiar with gated neighborhoods near Windward and newer developments around Avalon and downtown.
tips: Ask about custom crating for antiques, art or other fragile pieces.
Vault storage is an option if your move-out and move-in dates do not line up.
Businesses can request weekend or after-hours moves to avoid downtime.

name: MaidPro Alpharetta
desc: Locally owned MaidPro franchise serving Alpharetta since 2004 with recurring, one-time, deep and move-out house cleaning built around a 49-point checklist.
about: MaidPro Alpharetta is a locally owned franchise of the national cleaning brand, run by owner Tom Nguyen and operating in the area since 2004. The office is on Branch Drive in Alpharetta and serves the surrounding North Fulton ZIP codes.

Cleanings follow MaidPro's 49-Point Checklist and can be booked weekly, every other week, monthly or as a one-time deep clean. The location also offers move-in and move-out cleaning, cleaning for short-term rental hosts on Airbnb and VRBO, pre- and post-holiday cleaning, and add-on services such as laundry and linen changes.

Cleaners are hired, trained, insured, bonded and employed by MaidPro rather than subcontracted. Gift cards are sold online and emailed within a day of purchase, and the office keeps weekend hours for scheduling questions.
tips: Pick monthly service if you keep up with tidying and just want periodic help.
Short-term rental hosts can set up turnover cleans between guests.
Ask about add-ons like laundry or linen changes when booking a holiday clean.

name: Merry Maids North Atlanta Metro
desc: Locally run, woman-led Merry Maids franchise on Holcomb Bridge Road, cleaning North Fulton homes for over 25 years with recurring, one-time and specialty services.
about: Merry Maids North Atlanta Metro is the local franchise of the national cleaning brand, with an office on Holcomb Bridge Road in Alpharetta. It describes itself as a locally run, woman-led business that has cleaned homes across North Fulton County for more than 25 years.

Services include recurring maid service, one-time cleanings and specialty cleaning, with programs customized to each household's schedule and priorities. Special requests, such as focusing on baseboards or a cluttered room, can be built into a visit. The team suggests a deep clean every 6 to 12 months for homes without regular service.
The office is open on weekdays. The team supports local causes including Cleaning for a Reason, which provides cleanings for people undergoing cancer treatment, and Alzheimer's awareness efforts.
tips: Tell the office about focus areas so the team can spend extra time there.
Book a deep clean every 6 to 12 months if you do not have regular service.
Call during weekday office hours to set up a recurring schedule.
address: 2660 Holcomb Bridge Rd, Suite 222, Alpharetta, GA 30022

name: Five Star Painting of Alpharetta
desc: Locally owned Five Star Painting franchise on Holcomb Bridge Road handling interior and exterior house painting and cabinet refinishing in Alpharetta, Roswell, Milton and Johns Creek.
about: Five Star Painting of Alpharetta is an independently owned franchise of the Neighborly painting brand, working from an office on Holcomb Bridge Road. It serves Alpharetta, Roswell, Milton, Johns Creek and Duluth.

Work covers interior and exterior house painting along with cabinet painting, refinishing, door refacing and door replacement. The team stresses surface preparation, and for cabinets that means cleaning, sanding, priming and a proper coating system rather than wall paint. On brick homes, it often recommends painting trim, siding, shutters or the front door to update the look without painting all of the brick.
The company says many North Atlanta homes need exterior repainting roughly every six to eight years, depending on condition. Estimates are done on site, and phones are answered seven days a week.
tips: Ask about painting only trim, shutters and the front door on brick homes.
Get cabinet refinishing quoted separately; it involves more prep than walls.
Have the exterior checked around the six to eight year mark.
address: 2662 Holcomb Bridge Rd, Unit 322A, Alpharetta, GA 30022

name: TRS Painting
desc: Alpharetta painting and remodeling contractor on North Main Street offering interior and exterior residential painting, commercial painting, drywall, flooring and pressure washing.
about: TRS Painting, LLC is a painting and remodeling contractor with its office on North Main Street, just north of downtown Alpharetta. It works on both homes and businesses.

Residential services include interior and exterior painting, and the company also handles commercial painting, drywall installation, flooring installation and pressure washing. Additional outdoor work includes custom deck building and fence installation, which makes it an option when a project mixes paint with light carpentry or repairs.

The company says its crews are bilingual and fully insured, and that its two project managers each have more than five years of experience in painting and contracting. Estimates are free, and the office is open weekdays plus Saturday mornings, so homeowners can call before or after a typical workday to set up a visit.
tips: Bundle drywall repair with painting so one crew handles both.
Ask about pressure washing before an exterior repaint.
Call on a weekday or Saturday morning to book a free estimate.

name: Graves Overhead Doors
desc: Family-owned garage door company since 1998 with a Cumming showroom just north of Alpharetta, installing and servicing residential and commercial garage doors and openers.
about: Graves Overhead Doors is a family-owned company that has installed and serviced garage doors in the North Atlanta, Cumming and Alpharetta area since 1998. Owner Lee Graves leads the team, and the company is IDEA accredited.

Work covers residential garage doors, commercial doors and openers, including new installations, repairs and ongoing maintenance. Same-day service is offered, and after-hours and emergency service is available for doors that will not open or close.

The office and showroom are on Aaron Sosebee Road near GA 400, just off GA 20 West north of Alpharetta, and visitors are welcome to see door styles in person during weekday hours. Estimate requests can be made online with a preferred morning or afternoon time, and the team will follow up to confirm.
tips: Visit the showroom to compare door styles before you order.
Ask about same-day service for a broken spring or stuck door.
After-hours emergency service is available outside office hours.

name: Balanced Garage Doors
desc: Alpharetta garage door company on Hembree Road offering spring replacement, opener repair, maintenance and new door installation, with 24/7 emergency service.
about: Balanced Garage Doors is a garage door repair and installation company with its office on Hembree Road in Alpharetta, plus a second location in Lawrenceville. It serves Alpharetta, Atlanta, Marietta, Lawrenceville and the northern metro area.

Common jobs include broken spring replacement, opener repair and installation, routine maintenance and full residential door replacement. The company uses powder-coated, extended-life springs and offers a free 25-point inspection with no service fee. It also says it can often dispatch a technician within a few hours for emergencies.

Regular service hours run weekdays and Saturdays, with the office staffed Monday through Friday and emergency service available around the clock. An adult needs to be present at the start of the visit to approve the work order and at the end to review the job.
tips: Ask about extended-life springs when replacing a broken one.
Have an adult home at the start and end of the appointment.
Call the emergency line if a door is stuck open after hours.

name: Aaron Overhead Doors
desc: Family-owned garage door company with a Mayfield Road location, offering same-day spring repair, opener installation, panel replacement, maintenance and custom door installs.
about: Aaron Overhead Doors is a family-owned garage door company with locations in Buford, Atlanta and on Mayfield Road in the Milton and Alpharetta area. It serves North Fulton communities including Alpharetta and Milton.

Services include garage door repair, new and custom garage door installation, opener installation, spring replacement, panel replacement and routine maintenance. The company advertises same-day spring repair at no extra cost and handles LiftMaster opener warranty replacements.

Customers can call or text around the clock or schedule online, and the company maintains a showroom and online gallery for comparing door styles. It is a good fit for homeowners who need fast help with a broken spring or opener as well as those planning a full door upgrade for better curb appeal.
tips: Text the number if you cannot talk during work hours.
Ask whether a failed opener is still under manufacturer warranty.
Browse the online gallery before choosing a new door style.

name: Collins Pool Management
desc: Alpharetta-based commercial pool company on Hembree Road providing maintenance, repairs, renovations, lifeguards and pool monitors for HOAs and community pools.
about: Collins Pool Management is a commercial pool service company headquartered on Hembree Road in Alpharetta, with a second office in Stockbridge. It works across the greater Atlanta area, mainly with neighborhood, HOA, swim club and other commercial pools rather than single backyard pools.

Services include routine maintenance and cleaning, equipment repair, pool renovations, and lifeguard and pool monitor staffing. The company focuses on the extra regulatory and liability requirements of commercial pools, including chemical logs, staffing and equipment upkeep, and uses technicians trained for Georgia pool rules.

Service hours run Monday through Saturday, and the company says staff are reachable year-round for urgent needs. It offers free onsite consultations, so it suits HOA boards, swim clubs and property managers planning a season or a renovation.
tips: HOA boards can request a free onsite consultation before pool season.
Ask about lifeguard or pool monitor staffing for community pools.
Plan renovations in the off-season to avoid summer closures.

name: Leslie's Pool Supplies Alpharetta
desc: Leslie's pool and spa store on Highway 9 offering free AccuBlue water testing, free in-store repair labor, installation services, chemicals and pool equipment.
about: Leslie's Alpharetta is a local store of the national pool and spa chain, located on Highway 9 North and serving Alpharetta, Milton, Crabapple and nearby neighborhoods.

The store offers free AccuBlue water testing, a 10-point test from a water sample that takes about a minute and comes with a treatment plan. It also provides free in-store repair labor on pool components, installation services, and troubleshooting help for equipment such as pumps, motors, heaters and automatic cleaners. Shelves carry chemicals, chlorine tablets, cleaning attachments, above ground pools and floats.

Staff can help with chemical balancing and equipment recommendations, making the store a practical first stop before calling a technician. It is open six days a week and closed Sundays, with the same hours Monday through Saturday.
tips: Bring a water sample in a clean container for the free test.
Ask about free in-store repair labor before replacing a part.
Shop on Saturday since the store is closed Sundays.

name: P.F. Chang's Alpharetta
desc: Chinese and Asian restaurant on North Point Parkway known for its chicken lettuce wraps, with dumplings, noodles, happy hour, patio seating and catering.
about: P.F. Chang's Alpharetta sits at 7925 North Point Parkway in the North Point shopping corridor. It is part of the national P.F. Chang's chain and serves a broad Chinese and Asian menu for lunch and dinner, seven days a week.

The signature dish is Chang's Chicken Lettuce Wraps.
